The Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has declared Result-II for the recruitment of Post Graduate Teachers (PGTs) in Computer Science on 21 August 2026. This result is in continuation of the earlier result declared on 12 August 2026 and covers recommended candidates for Rest of Haryana (ROH) Cadre and Mewat Cadre under Advt. No. 23/2026, for posts under the Secondary Education Department, Haryana. Candidates who appeared for the HPSC PGT Computer Science recruitment process can check their roll numbers in the list below.

HPSC PGT Computer Science Result 2026 - Quick Overview

Particular Details
Conducting Body Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC), Panchkula
Post Name Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) – Computer Science
Advertisement Number 23/2026
Department Secondary Education Department, Haryana
Cadres Covered Rest of Haryana (ROH) Cadre and Mewat Cadre
Result Type Result-II (in continuation of earlier result)
Previous Result Declared On 12 August 2026
Current Result Declared On 21 August 2026
Result Status Final list of candidates recommended for appointment (provisional, subject to verification)
Official Website hpsc.gov.in

About HPSC PGT Computer Science Result-II 2026

This Result-II is a continuation of the result HPSC first declared on 12 August 2026 for the PGT Computer Science posts under Advt. No. 23/2026. The Commission has now released an additional list of candidates recommended for appointment, in ascending order of roll number, separately for the ROH Cadre and the Mewat Cadre. The recommendation is issued by the Deputy Secretary, HPSC, Panchkula, and is dated 21 August 2026.

Important Notes on HPSC PGT Computer Science Result 2026

HPSC has issued the following clarifications along with the Result-II declaration. Candidates are advised to read these carefully, as they directly affect the finality of the result.

Error Rectification Clause

While preparing the result, due care has been taken by the Commission. However, the possibility of any inadvertent error cannot be ruled out, and the Commission reserves the right to rectify any error at a later stage.

Vacant and Withheld Posts

A total of four (4) posts three (3) under the General category and one (1) under the BCA category have been kept vacant on account of pending court cases. In addition, the result of 10 candidates has been withheld on account of pending clarifications from the Government or the Department.

Pending Writ Petitions

The declared result is subject to the final outcome of the following pending writ petitions before the Punjab and Haryana High Court, along with one Special Leave Petition (SLP) before the Supreme Court:

Case Type Case Numbers
LPA 779/2026
CWP 6721/2026, 6831/2026, 23502/2026, 23703/2026, 24501/2026, 23933/2026, 6707/2026, 11147/2026, 14744/2026, 23225/2026, 24718/2026, 24455/2026, 24435/2026, 25558/2026, 25337/2026, 26400/2026, 26056/2026, 25628/2026, 26095/2026
SLP (C) Diary 38840/2025

Provisional Nature of Result and Document Verification

The recommendation made in HPSC PGT Computer Science Result-II 2026 is provisional and is subject to verification of essential qualification, degree, and caste certificates by the Secondary Education Department, Haryana. Candidates should keep their original documents ready for verification as and when called by the Department.

Also Read: IBPS SO Admit Card 2026

How to Check HPSC PGT Computer Science Result 2026

Candidates who wish to verify their roll number can visit the official HPSC website at hpsc.gov.in and look for the Result-II notice related to PGT Computer Science under Advt. No. 23/2026 on the Results or Recruitment section of the homepage. The notice opens as a PDF listing recommended roll numbers cadre-wise, which candidates can also cross-check against the roll number tables provided on this page. Since the result is available only as a roll-number list, candidates are advised to keep their admit card or application details handy while checking, as no separate scorecard or merit list format has been released by the Commission for this result.

The Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) has released the provisional result for the Sevak/Sevika and Tribal Language Teacher (TLT) recruitment. This OSSSC Sevak Sevika Result 2026 update covers the official notice details, district allocation, how to check your result, and what "provisional" means for candidates before any final appointment.

Click to Check OSSSC Sevak Sevika Result 2026

OSSSC Sevak Sevika Result 2026 - Quick Overview

OSSSC published the provisional result for Sevak/Sevika and Tribal Language Teacher posts on 20 August 2026 under Notice No. IIE-96/2025-2553/OSSSC. The result includes roll numbers of provisionally selected candidates along with district cadre allocation, based on marks in the Main Examination, document verification, eligibility, category availability, and candidates' own choices.

What Is Mentioned in the OSSSC Result Notice?

The official notice (No. IIE-96/2025-2553/OSSSC, dated 20 August 2026) states the following:

  • Roll numbers of provisionally selected Sevak/Sevika candidates are given in Annexure-I.
  • Roll numbers of provisionally selected Tribal Language Teacher candidates are given in Annexure-II.
  • District cadre allocation has been made for provisionally selected candidates.
  • Selection is based on Main Examination marks, document verification, eligibility conditions, and candidates' choices.
  • Category-wise seat availability was considered while making the allocation.

Also Read: UPSSSC Pharmacist Final Answer Key 2026

How to Check OSSSC Sevak Sevika Result 2026

OSSSC has advised candidates not to depend on unofficial result websites. Follow these steps to check your individual result on the official portal:

  1. Visit the official OSSSC website at osssc.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your registered User ID and Password.
  3. Open the candidate home page after a successful login.
  4. Click on the "Results/Marks" menu.
  5. Select the relevant result link for Sevak/Sevika or Tribal Language Teacher.
  6. View your marks, selection status, and district allocation (if applicable).
  7. Download or save your result details for future reference.

OSSSC Sevak Sevika District Allocation

Along with the provisional selection, OSSSC has allocated candidates to different district cadres. This allocation considers the applicable recruitment conditions and the district choices candidates exercised during the online application process. Provisionally selected candidates should verify their allotted district carefully and watch for further official instructions regarding appointment or subsequent formalities.

Also Read: UPSSSC BCG Technician Final Answer Key 2026

Important Instructions: Is This the Final Result?

This is an important distinction for candidates: the result published on 20 August 2026 is provisional, not a final, unconditional appointment order. The official notice states that the result is subject to the final outcome of cases currently pending before the Hon'ble High Court of Orissa, as well as similar related cases.

  • Keep a copy of your result and district allocation details safely.
  • Check the official OSSSC portal regularly for further instructions.
  • Do not rely on social media messages for appointment-related information.
  • Follow only official notices issued by OSSSC for the next stage.

How to Download the SSC MTS Havaldar Result PDF 2026

  1. Visit the official SSC website: ssc.gov.in
  2. Click on the "Result" section on the homepage.
  3. Select the MTS examination tab.
  4. Open the link for "MTS & Havaldar Examination 2026 Result."
  5. Download the PDF and use Ctrl + F to search your roll number.

Details Mentioned on the SSC MTS Result PDF

The SSC MTS Havaldar Result PDF includes the following details for shortlisted candidates:

  • Name of the Commission
  • Examination Name
  • Candidate's Name
  • Roll Number
  • Category applied for

Candidates should carefully verify these details and immediately contact the concerned SSC Regional Office in case of any mismatch.

SSC MTS Havaldar Tie-Resolution Criteria

If two or more candidates score the same marks, SSC resolves ties using the following order:

  1. Candidate with higher normalised marks in the General Awareness section of Session II
  2. Candidate with higher overall normalised marks in Session II
  3. Candidate who is older in age (based on Date of Birth)
  4. If the tie still remains, candidates are ranked in alphabetical order of their names

SSC MTS Score Card 2026

Marks of both qualified and non-qualified candidates will be uploaded on the SSC website after the final result is declared. Candidates will be able to check their marks by logging in with their registration number and date of birth. The exact score card release date has not been officially announced yet.

What's Next After the SSC MTS Havaldar Result 2026?

Post Applied Next Stage What Happens After
MTS Document Verification Final merit list is prepared and appointment process starts
Havaldar PET & PST (24-31 August 2026) Candidates who qualify move to the final merit list and further formalities

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Download and save a copy of the result PDF, cut-off PDF, and PET notice for future reference.
  • Candidates whose results were withheld or not processed due to malpractice should contact the relevant SSC Regional Office directly; do not rely on unofficial sources for status updates.
  • Havaldar candidates should begin PET/PST preparation immediately, given the short window before the 24-31 August 2026 test dates.
  • Always cross-check vacancy numbers, cut-off marks, and dates with the official SSC notice, since figures reported by different portals can vary slightly until SSC issues a final confirmation.

MPPSC Assistant Manager Result 2026 - Direct Link

Candidates can check and download the MPPSC Assistant Manager Result 2026 / Final Selection List from the official website of the Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC). The final selection list for the Assistant Manager Exam 2024 was released on 19 August 2026 and has been prepared based on the combined marks obtained in the written examination and interview.

Direct Link: MPPSC Assistant Manager Exam 2024 - Result List 2026

Important Notes / Instructions

  1. As per the MP General Administration Department circular (No. F-7-46/99/A.P./One, Bhopal, dated 07.11.2000), candidates from reserved categories are selected against Unreserved (Open) posts only if they qualify strictly on merit, equal to general category candidates, without availing any relaxation.
  2. As per MP General Administration Department circular (No. C/3-2/97/3/One, Bhopal, dated 10.02.1997), if a sufficient number of women candidates are not available for women-reserved posts, such posts are filled by male candidates of the same category.
  3. The declared selection result remains subject to the final decision of SLP No. 8764/2023, SLP No. 12398/2023 pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, and Writ Petition No. 5901/2019 and Writ Petition No. 5596/2024 pending before the Hon'ble High Court, along with other similar pending petitions.
  4. Out of the 59 posts advertised under the Main Part (87%), 4 posts were reserved for the Divyang (PwD) category Locomotor Disability-1, Hearing Impaired-1, Visually Impaired-1, Multiple Disability-1. Since eligible Divyang candidates were not available, 3 of these posts (Hearing Impaired-1, Visually Impaired-1, Multiple Disability-1) remain vacant in the Divyang category. As per government instructions, an equal number of posts are kept vacant from the Unreserved category against vacant Divyang posts hence, against these 3 vacant Divyang posts, 2 available Unreserved (Open) category posts have also been kept vacant.
  5. The selection results of candidates involved in pending court cases have been kept on hold, subject to the final decision of the respective court.
  6. If any computer or clerical error is noticed by the Commission after publication of the result, MPPSC reserves the right to correct the result.

  • Pay scale/salary of the Assistant Manager post
  • Educational qualification/eligibility criteria
  • Age limit

CSBC Bihar Police Selection Process 2026

Selection for Prohibition Constable, Jail Warder, and Mobile Squad Constable follows three stages, governed by the respective Bihar cadre recruitment rules for each post:

  1. Written Examination - candidates scoring below 30% are not considered for the next stage.
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) - includes physical measurements and efficiency tests such as running, long jump, and high jump.
  3. Document Verification - for candidates who qualify PET/PST.

Candidates were shortlisted for PET/PST at up to five times the number of vacancies in each reservation category, reducible where enough eligible candidates were not available. A total of 19,681 candidates have been shortlisted for this stage, spread across three separate merit lists:

  • List 1 - Ex-Servicemen candidates qualified for PST.
  • List 2 - Home Guard candidates qualified for PET.
  • List 3 - General/direct-recruitment candidates (all categories, including women, transgender, and Freedom Fighter Ward candidates) qualified for PET.

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination

  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.

Union Bank of India Apprentice Selection Process

As per the result notice, final selection depends on successful completion of the following activities after the provisional result:

  1. Fulfilment of eligibility criteria/conditions as prescribed in the notification dated 28.04.2026, verified during Document Verification.
  2. Language Proficiency Test (for applicable candidates).

The Bank has clearly stated that selection is provisional and subject to production of all relevant documentary evidence supporting eligibility at the time of reporting.

Documents Required for Union Bank of India Apprentice Document Verification

Selected candidates must carry the following documents at the time of reporting:

  • 10 photographs (as uploaded on the NATS Portal)
  • Address Proof (Permanent and Communication)
  • PAN Card / Proof of PAN allotment
  • Aadhaar Card
  • All original certificates supporting eligibility (10th/Matriculation, 12th onwards) — both Degree and Marksheet must be produced
  • Caste Certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates) and Permanent PwBD Certificate (for candidates under the Disabled Category); OBC Certificate must carry the "Non-Creamy Layer" clause
  • EWS Certificate valid for FY 2025-26, if applicable
  • One self-attested photocopy set of all documents/certificates/IDs
  • Medical Fitness Certificate from a practicing registered general physician (minimum MBBS qualification)
  • Printout of the NATS Portal profile

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Out - Check Provisional Allotment (CRP XIV)

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) released the IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 on 30th June 2026 for candidates who appeared in the CRP RRBs-XIV recruitment cycle. Candidates who were not allotted a bank in the main result can now log in to the official IBPS portal with their registration number and password/date of birth to check their provisional allotment status under the reserve list. The list currently covers 26 participating Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and shortlisted candidates will also be informed through email and SMS on their registered contact details.

What Is the IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026?

This section explains the purpose of the reserve list and why IBPS issues it after the main selection round.

A reserve list is a backup panel that IBPS prepares after declaring the final result of the CRP RRBs-XIV exam. Once the primary list of selected candidates is allotted to participating banks, some vacancies remain unfilled because certain selected candidates do not join within the deadline, resign shortly after joining, or get rejected at the document verification stage. To ensure every sanctioned post is filled, IBPS draws candidates from the reserve panel, based on merit, category, and the number of vacancies still open, and provisionally allots them to a Regional Rural Bank for the Office Assistant/Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026: Direct Link to Check

This section gives you the official login link to view your provisional allotment status under the reserve list.

Candidates who appeared in the IBPS RRB Clerk Mains exam but did not feature in the original selection list can check their status through the official IBPS portal. Login requires your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Login Link (Active)

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026 Online?

This section outlines the step-by-step process to view and download your reserve list allotment status.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
  2. Click on the "CRP-CSA (Customer Service Associate)" tab on the homepage.
  3. Select "CRP-CRP XIV – Provisional Allotment under Reserve List."
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code and click on the Login button.
  6. View your allotment status and download the result for future reference.

How Will You Know If You're Selected?

This section explains how IBPS notifies candidates who get provisional allotment through the reserve list.

Candidates who are provisionally allotted a bank through the reserve list will receive an official communication via email and SMS on their registered email ID and mobile number. It is advisable to regularly check your registered contact details and the official IBPS portal so you don't miss any update.

What Happens After the Reserve List Allotment?

This section explains the next stages candidates must complete after receiving a provisional allotment.

Getting your name on the reserve list does not mean final selection it is a provisional allotment that becomes confirmed only after the bank completes verification. The typical process that follows includes:

  • Document Verification: Submission of original certificates and identity proofs for cross-checking.
  • Submission of Required Certificates: Educational, category, and other eligibility-related documents as specified by the allotted bank.
  • Medical Examination: Some banks may require a fitness check before final confirmation.
  • Joining Formalities: Completion of paperwork and reporting to the allotted branch.
  • Induction/Training Process: Orientation and training conducted by the bank before you begin regular duties.

Candidates should keep all original and photocopied documents ready in advance to avoid last-minute issues during verification.

Why Does IBPS Release a Reserve List?

This section explains the broader purpose behind the reserve list mechanism in IBPS recruitment.

A reserve list helps maintain smooth recruitment by ensuring sanctioned vacancies don't remain vacant. It benefits candidates who narrowly missed the initial cut-off by giving them another opportunity, while also helping banks manage manpower requirements efficiently across states and categories.

This test is not the main VAO recruitment exam. SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

  2. Diploma or equivalent in the field of music for candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical Music from any recognized University. OR
  3. Certificate of participation/ awards presented at various events. For such candidates’ performance/ playing of blowing instruments with staff notation.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake Online Form 2026 : Physical Eligibility Details

  • Height –
  1. For Male candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 162 cms.
  2. For Female candidates: Minimum acceptable height is 152 cms. For candidates belonging to North East or hilly regions of Uttarakhand, a lower minimum height of 147 cms will be accepted. In case of candidates from Lakshadweep, the minimum height will be 150 cms
  • Weight – Weight should be proportionate to height and age as applicable for IAF.
  • Chest –
  • For Male Candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed. Minimum chest circumference should be 77 cms and the chest expansion should be at least 05 cms
  • For Female candidates: The chest wall should be well proportioned and well developed with the minimum range of expansion of 05 cms.
  1. Hearing – Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.
  2. Dental – Should have healthy gums, good set of teeth and minimum 14 dental points.
  • Visual Standards – 6/12 each eye, correctable to 6/6 each eye; Maximum limits of Refractive Error:- Hypermetropia: +2.0D, Myopia: 1D, Including ± 0.50 D Astigmatism & Colour Vision: CP-II
  • Physical Fitness Test (PFT) – PFT consists of a 1.6 Km run to be completed within 7 minutes (For Male Candidates) and 1.6 KM run to be completed within 8 minutes (For Female Candidates).
  • Candidates will have to complete 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups and 20 squats Form (Male) & 10 sit-ups and 15 squats (Female).

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for CRP CSA-XVI, the 16th Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associate (CSA) posts - popularly known as IBPS Clerk Recruitment - in 11 participating Public Sector Banks. The vacancies are for the financial year 2027-28, and online registration opens on 01.08.2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for the Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post under CRP CSA-XVI, with indicative state-wise vacancies across 11 public sector banks (not less than 11,403 posts based on the state totals in the notification, though this figure is not stated as a national total in the notification itself - see the Vacancy Details section below). Graduates aged 20–28 years (as on 01.08.2026) can apply. Online registration runs from 01.08.2026 to 21.08.2026, applications are submitted only through the official IBPS website www.ibps.in, and posting is anywhere in India depending on the State/UT a candidate applies for.

IBPS Clerk (CRP CSA-XVI) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

IBPS has published the detailed notification for CRP CSA-XVI on its official website. Candidates should read the full notification carefully before applying, since it contains state-wise vacancy breakups, reservation details, and document requirements.

IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 Overview

IBPS Clerk Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

IBPS has indicated state-wise and category-wise vacancies for the Customer Service Associate post across 11 participating banks in Annexure-I of the notification. The vacancies are described as indicative and anticipated, and the final numbers depend on actual requirements reported by the participating banks closer to the provisional allotment stage. Union Bank of India's vacancies are marked "NR" (Not Reported) in every state/UT, so the totals below understate the true final vacancy count.

Note on totals: the notification gives a state-wise total for each State/UT (as shown below) but does not state one all-India grand total. IBPS Clerk Eligibility Criteria

The eligibility conditions below are the basic criteria for applying. IBPS clarifies that qualifying in the CRP and being provisionally allotted to a bank does not guarantee employment - the concerned bank retains the final say on appointment.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India
Age (as on 01.08.2026) Minimum 20 years, Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 02.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2006)
Educational Qualification (as on 21.08.2026) A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognised by the Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government
Local Language Proficiency Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the specified/opted local language of the State/UT they apply for (see Local Language Proficiency Test section)
Computer Literacy Mandatory - a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations, or having studied Computer/IT as a subject in High School/College

IBPS Clerk Qualification for Ex-Servicemen

Ex-Servicemen who do not hold the above civil qualification are eligible if they are matriculate Ex-Servicemen who obtained the Army Special Certificate of Education (or the equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate) after completing at least 15 years of service in the Armed Forces, with the certificate dated on or before 21.08.2026.

IBPS Clerk Age Limit

The standard age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 01.08.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to reserved categories as follows:

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 years
Ex-Servicemen/Disabled Ex-Servicemen Actual period of service in defence forces + 3 years (8 years for Disabled Ex-Servicemen belonging to SC/ST), subject to a maximum age of 50 years
Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried) Age concession up to 35 years for General/EWS, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC/ST

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is available cumulatively with only one of the other relaxation categories listed above (Point II 3 to 5 of the notification), not with more than one.

IBPS Clerk Application Fee

The application fee (inclusive of GST) must be paid online between 01.08.2026 and 21.08.2026:

  • SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates: ₹175
  • All other candidates: ₹850

Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. Payment can be made via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI. A correction fee of ₹200 (inclusive of GST) applies if a candidate uses the Edit Window to modify the submitted application.

Also Read: Bank Jobs 2026 | Government Jobs After Graduation | SSC and Banking Exam Calendar 2026

IBPS Clerk Salary

The Customer Service Associate post carries the following basic pay scale, plus allowances and perquisites as applicable in the allotted participating bank:

Post Basic Pay Scale
Customer Service Associate (CSA) ₹24050-1340/3-28070-1650/3-33020-2000/4-41020-2340/7-57400-4400/1-61800-2680/1-64480

The Customer Service Associate is eligible for allowances and perquisites as per the rules of the participating bank in force from time to time. Exact take-home pay after allowances is not specified in the notification, since it varies bank to bank.

IBPS Clerk Selection Process

Selection for CRP CSA-XVI is a two-tier process consisting of an Online Preliminary Examination and an Online Main Examination, followed by a qualifying Local Language Proficiency Test before joining.

Preliminary Examination (Objective Test)

Test Medium No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Allotted
English Language English 30 30 20 minutes
Numerical Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 35 35 20 minutes
Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 35 35 20 minutes
Total - 100 100 60 minutes

Main Examination (Objective Test)

Test Medium No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Allotted
General/Financial Awareness English/Hindi (as opted) 40 50 20 minutes
General English English 40 40 35 minutes
Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 40 60 35 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude English/Hindi (as opted) 40 50 35 minutes
Total - 160 200 125 minutes

There is a penalty of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations. No penalty applies to unattempted questions. Candidates must clear individual cut-offs in each test as well as an overall cut-off. Only marks obtained in the Main Examination are considered for the final merit list; Preliminary Exam marks are used only for shortlisting.

Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the State/UT they apply for. Candidates who have studied that language up to Class 10 or above are exempt from a separate test. Others must clear a qualifying (marks-based) Local Language Proficiency Test conducted after the Main Exam/provisional allotment but before joining - failing this test means disqualification from the process.

Provisional Allotment

Shortlisted candidates are provisionally allotted to one of the participating banks based on merit-cum-preference and State/UT-wise vacancies reported to IBPS. A reserve list of approximately 30% of vacancies in each category may also be maintained, though this does not guarantee eventual allotment. Provisional allotment is subject to identity verification and the candidate being found medically fit and otherwise eligible by the allotted bank.

Check IBPS Clerk Syllabus 2026

IBPS Clerk - Documents Required

The following original documents (with self-attested photocopies) must be produced at the time of joining/document verification, as applicable:

  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Class X certificate with DOB)
  • Photo identity proof as specified in the notification
  • Graduation mark-sheets and degree certificate
  • Class 10 or above mark-sheet/certificate for the local language (if applicable)
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed format (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates)
  • Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates)
  • Disability certificate in the prescribed format (for PwBD candidates)
  • Ex-Servicemen certificates as per Proforma A/B/C/D, as applicable
  • No Objection Certificate (for candidates already in Government/PSU service)
  • Any other document supporting the claimed eligibility

How to Apply for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only - no other mode of application is accepted.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website www.ibps.in and open the "CRP CSA" link, then click "Click Here to Apply Online for CRP – Customer Service Associates (CRP-CSA-XVI)".
  2. Click "Click Here for New Registration" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by email/SMS).
  3. Upload the required scanned documents: photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, SSC/SSLC/10th standard or equivalent certificate, and the certificate mentioned in Clause K(ix) if applicable - as per the specifications in Annexure IV of the notification.
  4. Carefully fill in all sections of the online application form using the "Save and Next" facility to verify details before final submission, since most fields cannot be edited after submission.
  5. Indicate the State/UT for which you want to be considered for provisional allotment - this choice is irrevocable once submitted.
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online through the integrated payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/Wallets/UPI).
  7. On successful payment, take a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for your records.

Free IBPS Clerk Mock Test Link 2026

Candidates preparing for the IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 (CRP CSA-XVI) can boost their exam preparation by attempting the Free IBPS Clerk Mock Test. The mock test is designed according to the latest IBPS Clerk exam pattern and helps candidates practice important questions, improve speed, accuracy, and time management before the Preliminary and Main examinations.

IBPS Clerk Mock Test Link 2026

IBPS Clerk Apply Online - Important Instructions

  • Fields such as Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, State/UT (vacancy, correspondence and permanent address), Post, and Nationality cannot be edited after submission.
  • A 2-day Edit Window is provided after the registration closing date to correct other details, for a fee of ₹200; dates for this window will be announced separately on the official website.
  • Not more than one application is allowed per candidate; in case of multiple applications, only the latest completed one is considered valid.
  • Any resulting dispute is subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts situated at Mumbai.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Candidates who have completed their graduation can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Bank Jobs 2026. Those preparing for banking exams may also check IBPS PO Recruitment 2026 and other All India Government Jobs for more opportunities.

BOB Local Bank Officer Age Limit

The age limit indicated below is for General category candidates as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026.

  • Maximum Age: 30 years

There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Officers' Cadre; only age relaxation as above applies. OBC candidates in the "creamy layer" are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation.

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

BOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process

Selection for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

  • Online Test (multiple sections, described below)
  • Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI)
  • Psychometric Test and/or any other assessment as deemed suitable by the Bank
  • Local Language Proficiency Test (LPT), where applicable

The tentative structure of the online examination is as follows:

- Total 120 120 120 Minutes

The English Language section is qualifying in nature only, and marks scored in it will not count towards the final merit list. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. The minimum qualifying marks for GD/PI are 60% for General category and 55% for Reserved category candidates. Candidates must qualify in the Local Language Proficiency Test unless they have studied the local language at the 10th or 12th standard level.

Eligible candidates can apply online for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.

  2. Go to the Career section/webpage and click on "Current Opportunities".

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website upsconline.nic.in/ora. A total of 80 vacancies have been announced through the UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026.

Candidates aged up to 35 years for UR/EWS, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC/ST who have a degree from a recognised university or equivalent are eligible to apply for these Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner vacancies. The online application process for UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 will start on 22 August 2026 and will remain open until 11 September 2026 up to 1800 hrs.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially released Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 for recruitment by selection to 80 posts of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) in the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour & Employment. The notification includes complete details on category-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee, Recruitment Test, interview, syllabus, salary, and online application procedure. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification carefully before applying. The notification is available on the official UPSC online application website.

  • Download UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF
  • Apply Online Link
  • Official Website

UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Overview

The full name of the recruiting body is the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), commonly referred to as UPSC. This notification, published as Special Advertisement No. 52/2026, covers recruitment by selection to the post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) under the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), which functions under the Ministry of Labour & Employment. The table below summarises the key details of UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026.

Total Vacancies 80 (Eighty)
Mode of Application Online, via upsconline.nic.in/ora
Application Start Date 22 August 2026
Application Last Date 11 September 2026 (1800 hrs)
Selection Process Recruitment Test (RT) followed by Interview
Job Location Headquarters: New Delhi (All India Service liability)
Official Website upsconline.nic.in/ora

UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Candidates planning to apply for UPSC APFC Vacancy 2026 should note the following schedule.

Event Date

The prescribed closing date for submission of the online application is also the date for determining candidates' eligibility in every respect.

Of the 80 posts, three vacancies are reserved for candidates with benchmark disability (PwBD), covering categories such as blindness and low vision, deaf and hard of hearing, and specified locomotor disabilities, as detailed in the official notification.

UPSC APFC Eligibility Criteria

UPSC APFC Qualification

Essential Qualification: A degree of a recognised university or equivalent.

Desirable Qualification: A diploma in Company Law, Labour Laws, or Public Administration.

The Commission may relax these qualifications at its discretion for otherwise well-qualified candidates, and the notification specifies criteria the Commission may use for shortlisting if the number of applications is large, including preference for desirable qualifications or relevant experience.

UPSC APFC Age Limit

Category Upper Age Limit
UR / EWS 35 years
OBC 38 years
SC / ST 40 years
PwBD Age relaxable up to 10 years, subject to a maximum age limit of 56 years

Additional age relaxation is available for Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers, Central/UT Government employees, and EPFO employees (up to 5 years), as per the concessions listed in the official notification.

UPSC APFC Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / EWS / OBC (Male) Rs. 25
Female / SC / ST / PwBD (any community) Exempted (No Fee)

Fee can be paid online using a Visa/Master/RuPay Credit or Debit Card, UPI, or internet banking. The fee, once paid, is not refunded or carried forward to any other examination.

UPSC APFC Salary

The post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner carries Level-10 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). The post is permanent and classified as Central Board Group "A", Non-Ministerial, equivalent to Group-A of the Central Government at the corresponding pay level. The probation period is one year, and the post carries All India Service liability, meaning selected officers may be required to serve anywhere in India.

UPSC APFC Selection Process

Selection to the post of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner is made through a Recruitment Test (RT) followed by a Personality Test/Interview.

Stage Details
Recruitment Test (RT) Objective type (multiple choice), 2 hours duration, conducted in English and Hindi, carrying 300 marks. Wrong answers attract a penalty of one-third of the marks assigned to that question.
Interview Carries 100 marks
Weightage (RT : Interview) 75 : 25
Minimum Qualifying Marks in Interview General/EWS: 50 and above; OBC: 45 and above; SC/ST/PwBD: 40 and above (out of 100)

The syllabus for the Recruitment Test broadly covers General English, Indian Culture and Heritage, developmental issues and the Indian economy, governance and the Constitution of India, general science and computer applications, elementary mathematics, statistics and mental ability, industrial relations and labour codes, principles of accountancy, auditing and insurance, and current events of national and international importance.

The Recruitment Test will be held at 84 designated centres across India, including cities such as Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Lucknow, with the full list published in the official notification. Centre allotment follows a first-apply-first-allot basis, subject to a ceiling on candidates per centre (except Chennai, Dispur, Kolkata, and Nagpur).

How to Apply for UPSC APFC Recruitment 2026

UPSC APFC Apply Online

Candidates must apply online through the Commission's website, upsconline.nic.in/ora. The portal has four modules: Account Creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form (CAF), which are common to all UPSC recruitments, plus a fourth, post-specific module for this vacancy.

  1. Create an account and complete the Universal Registration on the portal to receive a Universal Registration Number (URN).
  2. Fill in the Common Application Form (CAF) with personal, educational, and category details, and upload a photograph along with a live photo capture.
  3. Upload a signature signed three times on plain white paper, as per the prescribed format.
  4. Complete the post/vacancy-specific module for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner within the application window.
  5. Upload supporting documents (proof of date of birth, educational qualification, category certificate, disability certificate, etc.) as applicable.
  6. Pay the application fee online, if applicable, and submit the form before the closing date.
  7. Take a printout of the finally submitted application for future reference.

Applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction or alteration is allowed after final submission. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance rather than waiting for the closing date.

Important Instructions

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, or fall under the specific categories of Nepal/Bhutan subjects, Tibetan refugees, or persons of Indian origin migrated from certain countries, as defined in the notification.
  • All correspondence from the Commission will be made through the registered e-mail ID, so candidates must provide a correct and active e-mail address.
  • Persons already in regular Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department of their application.
  • Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned inside the examination/interview venue.
  • Candidates will undergo mandatory face authentication at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Furnishing false particulars or suppressing material information can lead to rejection of candidature and debarment from future examinations or Government employment.
  • Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as the ID document for verification.

Candidates who hold the required educational qualification and are appearing in the Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test (STET, 2026) may also apply, but must pass STET 2026 before the Preliminary Examination; the admit card for the Preliminary Examination will not be issued if STET 2026 is not cleared.

Qualification Snapshot by School Level

  • Primary (1–5): Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education, OR Senior Secondary with 4-year B.El.Ed., OR Graduation with a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education, OR Graduation/Senior Secondary with two-year D.Ed. (Special Education), as per NCTE norms.
  • Middle (6–8): Graduation with a two-year Diploma in Elementary Education, OR Graduation/Post-Graduation with B.Ed., OR 4-year B.A./B.Sc.Ed. or B.A.Ed./B.Sc.Ed., with the requisite subject combination for Language, Math & Science, or Social Science teachers as specified in the notification.
  • Secondary (9–10): Graduation/Post-Graduation in the relevant subject group with minimum 50% marks and B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised institution.

BPSC TRE-4.0 Selection Process

Selection is made in two stages - a Preliminary Examination and a Main Examination. There is no interview.

Stage 1: Preliminary Examination

  • Objective-type General Studies paper; all questions carry equal (1) marks.
  • Duration: 2 hours; Total marks: 150.
  • Each question offers 5 options (A, B, C, D, E); candidates must mark one option. Option (E) must be chosen if the candidate does not wish to attempt the question.
  • Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer, and 1/3 mark deducted for any question left unanswered without selecting option (E).
  • Covers general science, current national and international events, Indian history and Bihar's history, general geography, Bihar's geographical features, India's polity and economy, the freedom movement and Bihar's contribution, and general mental ability.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: General category 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/women/Divyang candidates 32% (with an additional 4% horizontal relaxation for women, subject to a minimum of 32%, applicable only to Bihar domicile candidates).
  • Number of candidates shortlisted for the Main Examination will be 2.5 to 10 times the total advertised vacancies, category-wise, based on merit.

Stage 2: Main Examination

Paper School Level Structure Marks
Paper 1 Primary (1–5) Part I – Language (qualifying, min 30%); Part II – General Studies 150
Paper 2 Middle (6–8) Part I – Language (qualifying); Part II – General Studies; Part III – Subject Paper 150
Paper 3 Secondary (9–10) & Special School Teacher Part I – Language (qualifying); Part II – General Studies; Part III – Subject Paper 150
Paper 4 Higher Secondary (11–12) Part I – Language (qualifying); Part II – General Studies; Part III – Subject Paper 150
  • Objective (MCQ) type, duration 2 hours for each paper; each question carries 1 mark.
  • Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong or unanswered question (same 5-option format as the Preliminary Exam).
  • Language paper (Part I) is qualifying only, with a minimum of 30% required; it does not count towards merit.
  • Same category-wise minimum qualifying marks apply as in the Preliminary Examination (General 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/women/Divyang 32%).
  • Merit is prepared from Main Exam marks - Part II only for Primary (1–5); Part II + Part III combined for all other levels. There is no re-evaluation.
Note: Guest teachers (Atithi Shikshak) meeting prescribed eligibility get service-based weightage marks of 5 marks per year of service, up to a maximum of 25 marks, added to their qualifying score in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations, per the applicable court orders and Education Department resolutions.

How to Apply for BPSC TRE-4.0 Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official BPSC OTR portal bpsconline.bihar.gov.in.
  2. Complete One Time Registration (OTR) via the "New User Registration" button using a valid, active email ID and mobile number (mandatory for all BPSC exams).
  3. After OTR, sign in to DigiLocker's Meri Pehchan portal (create a new account if you don't have one) and give consent to link your documents with the application, or proceed directly to the online application via the browser back option.
  4. Log in at bpsconline.bihar.gov.in/candidate/login and complete your profile in six steps: Personal Information, Address Information, Other Information, Qualification Information, Experience Information, and Photo/Signature Upload.
  5. Upload a live webcam photograph and scanned signatures in both Hindi and English.
  6. Review all entries, tick the declaration checkbox, and click "Submit and Lock Profile" (profile details cannot be edited after locking, except by unlocking before final submission).
  7. Go to the "New Application" tab, select this advertisement (No. 14/2026), choose your post/subject and up to 38 preferred districts in order of priority.
  8. Pay the applicable fee online (SBI Payment Gateway) and confirm payment.
  9. Click "Proceed to Application" and then "Submit Application" to finalise your form.
  10. Download and print the confirmed Application Form from the "My Account" tab for future reference.

The Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB), under the Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (MoEF&CC), has invited applications for 51 posts on contract basis under the project "Strengthening of Environmental Regulators (SER)-Phase-III Project" on River Ganga, vide Advertisement No. 02/WQM-II/2025-Admin.(R). The project is funded by the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) under the Namami Gange Programme up to 06.05.2028, and may be extended further. The CPCB Recruitment 2026 online application window is open from 24 August 2026 (10:00 AM) to 7 September 2026 (23:59 Hrs).

In short: CPCB is recruiting for 51 contract posts - Scientist-D, Scientist-C, Scientist-B, Assistant Manager (Finance), Administrative Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Taxonomist, Data Entry Operator, and Field Assistant; candidates with the relevant Master's/Bachelor's qualification, GATE/NET-JRF or professional experience as specified per post can apply; applications are online only with no fee; the last date is 7 September 2026; and selected candidates may be posted at CPCB's Regional Directorates in Lucknow, Kolkata, Chandigarh, or the Head Office in Delhi, with interviews held in Delhi.

CPCB Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

A total of 51 posts are notified across nine categories under the SER-Phase-III Project, as per the table below.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Scientist-D 01
2 Scientist-C 08
3 Scientist-B 12
4 Assistant Manager (Finance) 03
5 Administrative Assistant 01
6 Scientific Assistant (SA) 13

9 Field Assistant 08
  Total 51

The notification states there will be no reservation for these appointments, and the number of posts may increase or decrease as per requirement. Selected candidates may be posted at Regional Directorate Lucknow, Regional Directorate Kolkata, Regional Directorate Chandigarh, or CPCB Head Office, Delhi, at the Board's discretion.

CPCB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Essential qualification and required experience vary by post, as detailed below. Qualification, experience and age will be reckoned as on the last date for submission of application (07.09.2026), and no updating of qualification/experience is permitted after that date.

Scientist-D (01 Post)

Qualification: First class Master's in Environmental Science/Natural Science, OR First Class Bachelor's in Engineering/Technology (Environmental/Chemical/Civil/Energy and Environment/Biotechnology); AND cumulative impact factor of published papers not less than 10 (only UGC CARE list/Scopus-indexed journals considered), OR minimum 5 books/edited book chapters published by National/International publishers with an established peer-review system and ISBN, OR minimum 5 technical reports published by CPCB/State Pollution Control Board (SPCB).
Experience: 7 years of relevant practical experience from reputed organizations in prevention, control & abatement of river pollution, industrial pollution, sewage management and environmental management; familiarity with environmental norms and data analytics required.

Scientist-C (08 Posts)

Qualification: Same Master's/Bachelor's requirement as Scientist-D; AND cumulative impact factor not less than 7, OR minimum 3 books/edited book chapters (ISBN, peer-reviewed), OR minimum 3 technical reports published by CPCB/SPCB.
Experience: 5 years of relevant practical experience in the same field as above.

Scientist-B (12 Posts)

Qualification: Same Master's/Bachelor's requirement as above; AND a valid GATE score with 90% or above percentile, OR NET-JRF qualified.
Experience: 3 years of relevant experience in the same field; candidates with relevant research/teaching experience will also be considered.

Assistant Manager (Finance) (03 Posts)

Qualification: First class Master's Degree in Commerce (Finance & Accounting/Taxation), OR Chartered Accountant, OR MBA (Finance & Accounting).
Experience: 8 years' post-qualification experience, including usage of computers and office software (MS Word, Excel etc.) with advanced knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages, minimum 2 years of tax experience, accounting entries in Tally & Quick Books, preparation of vouchers, filing online returns for TDS, GST, PF, ESI, STPI etc., and payroll preparation and management.

Administrative Assistant (01 Post)

Qualification: First Class Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University or equivalent, with working knowledge of computers. Desirable: First Class Post-Graduation degree.
Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience of administration work, preferably in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies, in the 4200/- grade pay or its equivalent; must pass a skill test based on noting and drafting.

Scientific Assistant (SA) (13 Posts)

Qualification: First class Master's in Environmental Science/Natural Science, OR First Class Bachelor's in Engineering/Technology (Environmental/Chemical/Civil/Energy and Environment/Biotechnology); AND a valid GATE score with 90% or above percentile, OR NET-JRF qualified.

Taxonomist (01 Post)

Qualification: First Class M.Sc. Desirable: Master's Degree in Botany or Zoology with minimum 75% marks or equivalent; AND a valid GATE score with 90% or above percentile/NET-JRF qualified; AND cumulative impact factor of published papers not less than 7 (UGC CARE list/Scopus-indexed journals only), OR at least 1 book/edited book chapter published (ISBN, peer-reviewed), OR at least 1 technical report published by CPCB/SPCB.

Data Entry Operator (04 Posts)

Qualification: First class Bachelor's Degree in Science/BCA. Must pass a skill test in MS Office (Word, Excel & PowerPoint), with English typing speed of 45 wpm and Hindi typing speed of 35 wpm, on computer.

Field Assistant (08 Posts)

Qualification: Passed 10+2 in Science with minimum 55% marks. Knowledge of water/wastewater sampling and sample preservation required.

General Notes on Qualification

  • Candidates must have passed the qualifying degree examination and been awarded the M.Sc./Bachelor's degree in engineering/technology (full-time regular courses only) from recognized Indian Universities/Institutes.
  • Period spent acquiring a Ph.D. degree will not be considered as experience.
  • Candidates with a Bachelor's in engineering/technology or an integrated Master's degree in engineering/technology will be considered for posts marked for engineering/technology streams; otherwise, candidates will be considered for posts marked for science streams.
  • Candidates who have received a degree or a valid provisional certificate as on the closing date of application may apply. Candidates awaiting final semester results, or final-year appearing students, are not eligible.

These engagements are purely contractual, co-terminus with the SER-Phase-III project, and carry no right to regularization or absorption into regular CPCB vacancies.

CPCB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

There is no application fee for applying to any of the 51 posts under this CPCB Recruitment 2026 notification, for candidates of any category.

CPCB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Recruitment will be made through interview, subject to document verification. Relevant documents, mark-sheets and experience certificates will be verified, and screening will be carried out. In case a large number of candidates apply for a position, the Selection/Screening Committee has discretion to shortlist candidates for interview based on a written exam, percentage of marks, desirable qualification/relevant experience, higher qualification, or any other criteria it deems fit. Only candidates qualifying the document verification and screening criteria will be called for interview by a Selection Committee. Candidates must bring original mark sheets, degrees, testimonials, date-of-birth certificates, experience certificates, self-attested photocopies of each document, Aadhaar card (or other Govt.-approved photo ID), and one passport-size photo for document verification. No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for attending the interview, which will be held in Delhi.

How to Apply for CPCB Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, in two steps, through the CPCB website:

  1. Step 1 – Registration: Visit www.cpcb.gov.in, go to the "Jobs" section, and register with a valid E-mail ID and active mobile number (both must be preserved till the end of the recruitment process). Enter the Name exactly as per the degree certificate (this field cannot be edited after registration), select the Post and Essential Qualification from the dropdown, and enter Date of Birth. Note down the generated Registration Number.
  2. Step 2 – Application Submission: Log in using the Registration Number and Date of Birth (which also serves as the password). Fill in post selection, qualification and experience details as per the advertisement; upload JPEG images of photo and signature, and the Experience Certificate. Recheck all entries before final submission.
  3. After submission, confirm the application status shows "submitted" - incomplete applications will not be considered, and CPCB will not be responsible for incomplete applications.
  4. Applicants required to upload only scanned copies of: (i) Experience Certificate(s), (ii) copy of PhD discipline (if applicable), and (iii) the page showing the applicant's name as author/co-author of any published Paper/Book/Journal; the same must also be produced at the time of interview.
  5. Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post.

Applications, once submitted, cannot be altered, resubmitted, or deleted under any circumstances - candidates are advised to keep all data ready before starting the online form.

CPCB Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only candidates of Indian Nationality can apply.
  • There is no reservation for these appointments, and the number of posts is liable to increase or decrease as per requirement.
  • These are purely temporary, contract engagements, co-terminus with the SER-Phase-III project; services will terminate automatically on expiry of the project or the appointment period, whichever is earlier, with no right to regularization/absorption.
  • Applicants currently serving in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU/Autonomous Organizations must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer and produce it at the time of document verification; failure to do so means the candidature will not be considered.
  • Candidates holding degrees/diplomas/certificates from institutions declared fake or de-recognized by UGC/AICTE/PCI are not eligible.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • CPCB reserves the right to withdraw the advertisement in part or whole, fill or not fill posts, or increase/decrease the number of posts, without assigning any reason.
  • Requests to change registered mailing address, e-mail address, or mobile number during the recruitment process will not be entertained.
  • Selected candidates must produce a Medical Certificate from an authorized Government Medical Officer at the time of joining.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum will be published only on the CPCB website - candidates should check regularly.
  • Persons previously dismissed by the Union/State Government, a Local Authority, or a Government Corporation/PSU are ineligible for appointment.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Role

The primary responsibility of a Customer Service Officer is to source customers and increase the sustainable portfolio of the branch.

The CSO has to identify new business locations, source potential customers and support their addition to the branch portfolio. After disbursement, the employee is also responsible for following up with customers and collecting installments on scheduled dates.

The key responsibilities of a NABFINS Customer Service Officer include:

  • Primary verification of client credentials.
  • Conducting Compulsory Group Training.
  • Data entry in CRIF.
  • Data entry in CMS.
  • Accompanying the Branch Manager for Group Recognition Test.

  • Generating demand.

BEML Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

Candidates who possess the required educational qualification and have passed their final examination within three years from the closing date of application are eligible to apply.

Qualification Category Applicable Trades/Disciplines
Graduate (Technical) – 4-yr Full Time Engineering Mechanical, Electrical Electronics, Civil, Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Automobile, Information Science, E&T, AI & ML, Aeronautical
Graduates (General) – 3-yr Full Time Graduation B.Sc, B.Com, BCA, BBA, BBA(HR)
Diploma – 3-yr Full Time Electrical Electronics, Civil, Computer Science, Electronics, Communication, Automobile, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering
ITI – Full Time (2 Year/1 Year based on trade) Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Electrician, COPA, Mechanic Diesel, Carpenter, Tool & Die Making, Sheet Metal, Plumber, Mechanic Auto Electrical & Electronics, MMV, Electronic Mechanic

Candidates are NOT eligible to apply in the following cases:

  • Awaiting the results of their final examination.
  • Not completed 17 years of age.
  • Have undergone or are undergoing apprenticeship training in any organization for any duration.

Please note:

  • Candidates must possess a full-time regular degree/diploma qualification from a recognized institute/university. Qualifications acquired through part-time/correspondence/distance education/online mode are not eligible.
  • Candidates should have passed out not before three years from the closing date of application; the date of result declaration should be clearly mentioned in the mark sheet, or supported by a certificate from the college/university.
  • The percentage of marks in the final examination of the qualifying degree (not semester-wise) should be mentioned in the final/consolidated mark sheet. If CGPA is mentioned, candidates must upload the Percentage Conversion Letter issued by their institute/university.
  • The required area of specialization (major/dual, if applicable) should be mentioned in the degree/diploma certificate; if not, a supporting certificate/letter from the college/institute/university is required.

Also Read: IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 470 Engineers, Officers and More Posts

BEML Apprentice Stipend 2026

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend based on their qualification category, subject to satisfactory performance and attendance.

Sl. No. Apprenticeship Trade Category Monthly Stipend
1 Graduate (Technical) – 4-yr Full Time Engineering Rs. 12,300/-
2 Graduates (General) – 3-yr Full Time Graduation Rs. 12,300/-
3 Diploma – 3-yr Full Time Rs. 10,900/-
4 ITI – Full Time (2 Year/1 Year based on trade) Rs. 9,600/- or Rs. 10,560/- (based on trade)

Poor performance or unauthorised absence may result in termination from the apprenticeship program. The total tenure of apprenticeship training is one year from the date of joining, co-terminated with completion of the one-year duration; no further extension is permitted.

BEML Apprentice Application Fee

There is no application fee for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026. There is also no written examination or interview process for applicants.

BEML Apprentice Age Limit

  • Applicants must be Indian citizens and 17 years old or above at the time of application.
  • Candidates who have not completed 17 years of age are not eligible to apply.

No upper age limit is specified in the notification.

Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

BEML Apprentice Selection Process

  • Applications will be screened as per eligibility criteria and prescribed qualification.
  • A category-wise merit list will be prepared for each trade at each location, in the ratio of 1:5 times the number of training slots notified.
  • Incomplete or ineligible applications will be summarily rejected without any intimation.
  • Reservation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) as per the Apprentices Act 1961 and Apprenticeship Rule 1992, as amended from time to time.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for document/certificate verification in order of merit, in a ratio of 1:5 with respect to the training slots notified/available. Communication will be through the candidate's registered email. No TA/DA will be paid for the document verification process.
  • A merit list will be prepared based on candidates found suitable at document verification, in order of the percentage of marks obtained in the final qualifying examination.
  • Offer of Engagement will be issued immediately to eligible candidates, subject to availability of training slots; remaining eligible candidates will be placed on a Reserved Waiting Panel, maintained at five times the training slot strength.
  • The Reserved Waiting Panel will be replenished periodically in merit order as vacancies arise.
  • Candidates will be engaged in merit order upon accepting the tri-partite apprenticeship contract on the NATS/NAPS website, and submission of a medical certificate (prescribed format) and police verification certificate.

BEML Apprentice Documents Required

  • Apprenticeship Registration/Enrolment Number under NATS/NAPS with a 100% completed/updated profile on the portal.
  • Scanned copies of educational certificates and mark sheets (clearly visible/readable).
  • Proof of age (Matriculation Certificate).
  • SC/ST/latest OBC(NCL) caste certificate as per Government of India formats (if applicable).
  • Bank cancelled cheque/first page of passbook (DBT-enabled account details).
  • Recent colour passport-size photograph and signature.
  • Identity card issued by the Government of India (e.g., Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, PAN Card, etc.).

Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account that is DBT-enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer, as per Government of India norms. The Name and Date of Birth of the applicant must match across the Matriculation (10th Class) Certificate, Aadhaar Card, and bank account.

How to Apply for BEML Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Step 1: Candidates must first register themselves (as a candidate/student) on:

  • NAPS for ITI trades at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, or
  • NATS for Degree/Diploma in Engineering at https://nats.education.gov.in/

and complete/update their profile by uploading all required documents.

Step 2: After obtaining the NAPS/NATS registration/enrolment number, candidates should apply on the BEML website as follows:

  1. Visit https://recruitment.bemlindia.in
  2. Go to Apprentices → Login/Registration
  3. Fill in the application form with the required details, including NAPS/NATS enrolment number and DBT-enabled bank account details.
  4. Upload all required documents as specified.
  5. Submit the application online before the last date.

Applications must be submitted online through the official BEML website only; no other mode of application will be accepted. There is no application fee, written examination, or interview process for applicants.

Also Read: RRB JE 04/2026 Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 4029 Junior Engineer Posts

BEML Apprentice Important Instructions

  • Candidates are permitted to submit only one application in a particular trade at a particular location.
  • Candidates submitting multiple applications, or applying for more than one location/trade, will not be considered and their applications will be summarily rejected.
  • Incomplete applications or those submitted without proper documents will be summarily rejected without any intimation.
  • Candidates found ineligible, or providing false information/documents that are not in order, will be disqualified at any stage during the engagement process or during the period of engagement.
  • Completion or undergoing of the apprenticeship program does not entitle the apprentice to any claim for employment with BEML.
  • Apprentices are not allowed to enrol in or undergo any regular course/job during their apprenticeship tenure.
  • Apprentices must maintain a weekly work-diary and submit it to the assigned reporting officer; they must also maintain confidentiality of BEML's proprietary information and adhere to the company's code of conduct.
  • Any Intellectual Property (inventions, discoveries, or works) created by apprentices during the apprenticeship will be the property of BEML.
  • BEML reserves the right to terminate the apprenticeship at any time for reasons including absenteeism, indiscipline, misconduct, poor performance, or violation of company policies.
  • BEML will not entertain any claims of injury/accident, theft, or other loss during the course of apprenticeship training.
  • Management reserves the right to amend the terms and conditions at any time; apprentices will be notified via email or official communication channels. BEML's decision will be final and binding.

The South Indian Bank Ltd. (SIB), a premier Scheduled Commercial Bank in India with its registered office in Thrissur, Kerala, has invited online applications from Indian Nationals for the post of Junior Officer / Business Promotion Officer (BPO), a target-based sales role. Online registration opened on 19 August 2026 and closes on 31 August 2026. There is no application fee, and eligible candidates must apply only through the Bank's official website, www.southindianbank.bank.in.

The Bank has specifically cautioned applicants to beware of fraudulent job alerts: applications are accepted only through the official online portal, and all recruitment-related communication will be sent exclusively through the applicant's registered email address.

SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particular Detail
Recruiting organisation The South Indian Bank Ltd. (SIB), Regd. Office: Thrissur, Kerala
Post name Junior Officer (Business Promotion Officer)
Job role Target-based sales role
Who can apply Indian Nationals meeting the age, qualification and experience criteria below
Application start date 19.08.2026
Application end date 31.08.2026
Application fee Nil
Mode of application Online only, via the Bank's official website
Posting location Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Ahmedabad regions (transferable anywhere in India at the Bank's discretion)
Official website www.southindianbank.bank.in

SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Activity Date
Online Application - Start Date 19.08.2026
Online Application - End Date 31.08.2026

Eligibility for this recruitment is reckoned as on 31.07.2026. Any revisions or corrigendum will be hosted only on the Bank's official website, so candidates should check it regularly.

Also Read: Bank of Baroda LBO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 2482 Local Bank Officer Posts

SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for the SIB Business Promotion Officer post is assessed as on 31.07.2026, based on the criteria below.

Criterion Requirement
Age limit Maximum 30 years (born on or after 01.08.1996). 5 years' age relaxation for SC/ST candidates.
Minimum qualification Graduation in any stream
Work experience Minimum 2 years of experience in a Bank/NBFC in retail assets / liability products

Important eligibility note: Candidates who have already attended a Group Discussion/Personal Interview for the Junior Officer role under any previous SIB notification(s), and were not included in the final selection list, are not eligible to apply again for this SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 drive.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

SIB Junior Officer (BPO) Terms of Employment

Particular Detail
Designation / Job role Junior Officer / Business Promotion Officer (a target-based sales role)
Term of appointment On contract, initially for 3 years, renewable subject to performance evaluation and business requirements, at the Bank's discretion
Career progression On completion of the initial or extended contract period, high-performing candidates identified by the Bank may - without any obligation and at the Bank's sole discretion - be considered for regular employment as Assistant Manager (Scale I), subject to the Bank's then-prevailing norms
Posting location Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Ahmedabad regions (see state-wise breakup below); liable to be transferred anywhere in India at the Bank's sole discretion; proficiency in the local language will be given preference

SIB Junior Officer Posting Region - State-wise Coverage

Region States Covered

Mumbai Region Maharashtra

Ahmedabad Region Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan

SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Salary / CTC

The total CTC at the time of joining is Rs. 7.85 lakhs per annum, structured as follows:

Component Amount
Fixed CTC (including NPS contribution) Rs. 4.49 lakhs
Variable Pay (performance-based) Rs. 2.88 lakhs
Health Insurance Premium paid by the Bank (coverage Rs. 5.25 lakhs) Rs. 0.48 lakhs
Total CTC Rs. 7.85 lakhs per annum

Additionally, Junior Officers posted under the Delhi, Mumbai and Pune regions are eligible for a special allowance of Rs. 10,000/month, and those posted under the Ahmedabad region are eligible for a special allowance of Rs. 5,000/month, after 3 months of active service and subject to performance review.

Other Benefits and General Terms of Employment

  • Official Duty allowance: Lodging allowance, halting allowance and travelling expense for official travel, as per Bank norms.
  • Insurance coverage: Group Medical Insurance and Group Accident Insurance provided at the Bank's cost; Group Life Insurance is arranged with the premium borne by the employee.
  • Other allowances, staff loans, perquisites, benefits and facilities applicable to the Bank's regular employees are not applicable to this contractual role.
  • Increment: Annual increment during the contract period is released based on performance evaluation or other parameters decided by the Bank from time to time.
