SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SIB Junior Officer (Business Promotion Officer) Recruitment 2026 is Nil for all categories of applicants.

SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for the SIB Business Promotion Officer post involves the following stages:

  • Shortlisting of applications
  • Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview
  • Psychometric Assessment

The Group Discussion is an elimination stage - only candidates shortlisted through the Group Discussion advance to the Personal Interview. Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to be called for the recruitment process. The Bank reserves the right to modify the selection process depending on the number of applications received, and to decide how many applicants are called forward at each stage. In all matters relating to eligibility and selection, the Bank's decision is final, and no further correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply for SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 - SIB Apply Online

Applicants can apply online through the Bank's website, www.southindianbank.bank.in, only between 19.08.2026 and 31.08.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Ensure you fulfil all the eligibility criteria before starting the application.
  2. Ensure the information provided in the online application form is correct before final submission - there is no provision to modify a submitted application.
  3. Ensure access to your registered email ID and contact number, and check them regularly, since all communication and updates are sent through these registered details only.
  4. Do not submit multiple registrations for the same role - applicants making multiple registrations will be disqualified.
  5. Enter your basic details and upload your photograph, signature and resume as per the specifications below.
  6. Note down the system-generated User ID (Application Reference ID) carefully for future reference; a confirmation email with registration details will be sent to your registered email ID.
  7. On successful submission, an email containing the application PDF and login credentials will be sent to your registered email ID.
  8. Confirm that your application has been submitted successfully by logging in to your profile - only successfully submitted applications will be considered.
  9. Keep a copy of the application for future reference. The physical copy of the application does not need to be sent to the Bank.

Photograph, Signature and Resume Upload Specifications

Document Specification
Photograph Recent passport-size colour photograph with a white background; casual photographs with caps, hats or dark glasses are not accepted. Resolution: 378 px (width) x 437 px (height). File size not more than 50 KB.
Signature Signed on white paper with a black ink pen. Resolution: 140 px (width) x 110 px (height). File size not more than 50 KB.
Resume PDF format only. File size should not exceed 1 MB.

Candidates are advised to visit the "Careers" page on www.southindianbank.bank.in for future updates, and to avoid last-minute rush near the closing date since Bank website access may be delayed due to heavy internet traffic.

SIB Junior Officer Recruitment 2026 - General Conditions

  • Applicants must fulfil all eligibility criteria (age, qualification, experience) at the time of applying; if any information furnished is later found false, the selection/appointment is liable to be terminated.
  • Upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years only for SC/ST candidates, who must submit attested certificates from a competent authority when called for.
  • Applicants should retain two copies of the photograph used in the application, for use during the recruitment process.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Applicants must appear for the recruitment process at their own cost.
  • Only applicants willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Appointment is subject to medical fitness and satisfactory background verification, including credit history/CIBIL check and police clearance, along with completion of other formalities as per Bank rules.
  • Shortlisting is provisional and without verification of original documents; candidature is subject to verification of all details/documents against originals at the time of interview/training/joining.
  • Interview call letters/advices, where required, will be sent only by email - no hard copy will be sent.
  • All revisions or corrigendum will be hosted only on the Bank's official website.
  • By submitting the application, the applicant consents to the collection, processing, storage, use and disclosure of their personal information and documents for purposes connected with the recruitment process and related administrative, legal and regulatory requirements, as detailed in the official notification.

NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), a subsidiary of NTPC Limited, has released Advertisement No. 04/26 to fill 147 vacancies across eight Engineer and Executive posts in the Renewable Energy (RE) segment. The engagement is on a fixed-term basis for 3 years, extendable by up to 2 years at the organisation's discretion. Online applications opened on 18 August 2026 at 10:00 Hrs and close on 7 September 2026 at 18:00 Hrs. Eligible Indian nationals can apply through the careers section of the official NGEL website, www.ngel.in.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification

Every post under NGEL Recruitment 2026 has its own qualification, experience and job-summary requirements. Candidates should check the post they intend to apply for carefully, since a candidate can apply for only one post among those advertised.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Civil) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Civil Engineering with at least 65% marks from a recognised university/institution (55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in Geotech/piling/foundation/structural steel/tower structures/switchyard, etc. Candidates with RE experience are preferred.
  • Job summary: Civil system design, technical specifications for regulatory compliance of solar, wind and other RE projects, contract management, quality assurance, equipment erection, installation, testing, commissioning, and O&M of the RE station.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Electrical) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electrical, Instrumentation & Control/Power Systems & High Voltage/Power Electronics/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in switchyard/electrical testing/transmission system/transformer/design/engineering. RE experience in the plant/engineering domain is preferred.
  • Job summary: Electrical system design and technical specifications for solar, wind and other RE projects, contract management for equipment erection, installation, testing, commissioning and O&M.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Mechanical) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Mechanical/Production/Industrial Engineering/Production & Industrial Engineering/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD). Preference is given to candidates with an ME/M.Tech degree.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience involving supervision/execution in power generation (Thermal/Gas/Hydro/Nuclear/Renewables). RE experience is preferred.
  • Job summary: Design and engineering of mechanical systems for RE projects, site selection, tender documentation, AutoCAD drawings, vendor drawing approval, supervision of equipment installation and O&M, and processing of statutory compliances.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Human Resource) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Graduate with at least a 2-year full-time Post Graduate Degree/Diploma/Programme in Management with specialisation in HR/Industrial Relations/Personnel Management, or MHROD, or MBA (HR) with at least 65% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in HR functions/Industrial Relations. Knowledge of SAP, MS Office and Data Analytics is preferred.
  • Job summary: Statutory labour-law compliance for RE areas, recruitment and onboarding, employee benefits and compensation, site infrastructure development, CSR execution around RE sites, and land acquisition/lease payment matters.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Finance) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Qualified CA or CMA.
  • Experience: Minimum 1 year post-qualification executive experience (excluding articleship period) in Finance/Accounts.
  • Job summary: Vendor invoice processing and payments, statutory compliance (GST, TDS, etc.), preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements as per IndAS and SEBI LODR, statutory/internal/government audits, costing, budgeting, financial projections, resource mobilisation, working capital management and payroll accounting.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Engineer (RE-Safety) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Production/Electrical/Civil/Power Engineering with at least 65% marks (55% SC/ST/PwBD) plus a full-time Diploma in Industrial Safety from a Regional Labour Institute/institution recognised under the Factories Act/Rules; OR a full-time Engineering Degree in Industrial Safety/Fire & Safety with at least 65% marks from a university/institution recognised under the Factories Act/Rules of any state.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in safety, preferably in the power or manufacturing industry (Govt./PSU or a private company of repute). Post-qualification experience is counted from the date of acquiring the engineering degree. RE experience is preferred.
  • Job summary: Statutory safety compliance under the Factories Act, developing/auditing/improving factory safety systems, safety-consciousness promotion, machinery/equipment/building safety inspection, emergency management planning, and organising safety and fire-fighting training and mock drills.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-CSR) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: Full-time PG Degree/Diploma/Programme in Rural Management/Rural Development/Displacement/Resettlement/Rehabilitation/Community Development/Local Governance/Local Development/Livelihoods/Social Entrepreneurship/Social Development/Social Administration/Sustainable Development/Development Policy & Practice/Development Studies, or MSW, or MBA, or a Graduate in Engineering, with at least 65% marks (55% SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification executive experience in conducting/reviewing/analysing/monitoring socio-economic surveys, stakeholder consultation through participatory tools, handling CSR activities under the Companies Act, need-assessment or social-impact-assessment surveys, or CSR project planning and implementation.
  • Job summary: Implementation of NGEL's CSR plan, drafting proposals, overseeing CSR activity execution, MIS preparation, payment processing, and handling internal and statutory CSR audits, reports and returns.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Executive (RE-Rajbhasha) Recruitment 2026

  • Qualification: A Master's Degree from a recognised university in Hindi (with English as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination), or in English (with Hindi as compulsory/elective subject or medium), or in any other subject with Hindi medium and English as compulsory/elective/medium, or with English medium and Hindi as compulsory/elective/medium, or with both Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or as medium and compulsory/elective subject, at the degree level. See the official notification for the exact combination of eligible qualifications.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years' post-qualification experience of using/applying terminology in Hindi or translation work from English to Hindi (or vice versa), under Central/State Government, Union Territories, autonomous bodies, statutory organisations, PSUs, universities, or recognised research and education institutions.
  • Job summary: Formation and coordination of the Official Language Implementation Committee, Hindi progress reports, organising Hindi Day/Fortnight and Hindi workshops, translation work (English to Hindi and vice versa), magazine editing, and implementation of Official Language Policy.
  • Age limit: 35 years.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit and Relaxation

The upper age limit for all eight posts is 35 years, computed as on the last date of receipt of the online application. Age relaxation is available as per government norms:

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • OBC candidates: 3 years relaxation
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years relaxation
  • Ex-Servicemen: relaxation as per applicable Government guidelines

Age relaxation applies where a vacancy is identified for that particular reserved category.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Salary / CTC

As per the notification, the approximate CTC for the advertised posts is Rs 11,00,000 per annum. This is indicative and includes both fixed and variable components, House Rent Allowance (HRA), Mediclaim for self, spouse, dependent parents and two children, performance-based variable pay, and a satisfactory service grant. The notification states that actual remuneration will depend on the candidate's experience, place of posting, and other terms and conditions of appointment.

Category Fee
General / EWS / OBC Rs. 500 (non-refundable)

Payment can be made online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Pre-Paid Card, or UPI within the application form itself. The notification states that the fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates should verify their eligibility before paying.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

NGEL may conduct a multi-stage selection process comprising application shortlisting/screening, a Computer-Based Test (CBT), Group Discussion and/or Interview, or a combination of these, and reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards if required.

If Selection is Through CBT

  • The CBT is bilingual with multiple-choice questions and has two sections: Section 1 – Subject Knowledge Test (SKT) (discipline-specific questions) and Section 2 – Aptitude Test (AT) (numerical ability, reading comprehension, reasoning, general awareness, data interpretation).
  • The test has 100 questions and a duration of 2 hours.
  • There is negative marking: ¼ of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for every wrong answer.
  • Online CBT centres: Kolkata, Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai, Vishakhapatnam, Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Jaipur, Bhopal and Raipur.
  • Shortlisted candidates from the CBT are called for an interview.

If No CBT is Conducted

Shortlisting will instead be done on the basis of age, qualification and experience, and shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview directly.

Additional notes on experience marking: 5 marks are awarded for meeting the minimum required experience, plus 1 additional mark for every extra year of experience, up to a maximum of 10 marks. The final offer of appointment is issued based on the candidate's relative rank in the merit list prepared from the cumulative total marks. Joining is subject to the candidate passing a medical examination at a specified government hospital and being declared medically fit.

Documents Required for NGEL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload the following documents while applying online:

  1. Class X/Matriculation passing certificate/marksheet and PAN Card, as proof of name and date of birth (name and DOB must match across all documents).
  2. Engineering consolidated marksheet/transcript/all-semester marksheets showing aggregate percentage of marks, or the CA/CMA (ICWA) passing certificate, or Master's degree certificate with marksheets, as applicable.
  3. Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for converting CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI into a percentage.
  4. Documents related to the essential qualification (pass certificate and marksheets, mode, duration, specialisation).
  5. Documents related to any other qualification (pass certificate and marksheets).
  6. Caste/Disability certificate, for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates, as applicable.
  7. OBC-NCL certificate in the central format for financial year 2026-27.
  8. EWS candidates: current-year Income & Asset certificate valid for FY 2026-27, based on FY 2025-26 income.
  9. Disability certificates as per the latest Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability for the post.
  10. Documents supporting the requisite years of post-qualification executive experience - in chronological order from the most recent organisation backward - including experience certificate, appointment/offer/joining letter, confirmation letter or training-completion order (if any), promotion order, role-assignment order, transfer order, service certificate, relieving letter, and two payslips per year.
  11. Self-attested copies of age proof, marksheets/transcripts and certificates for all qualifications, and experience certificates from all organisations specifically mentioning area of specialisation/job performed/expertise.
  12. Candidates from Government organisations/PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview, or submit an undertaking to provide it within a stipulated time / obtain proper relieving before joining NGEL, if selected.

How to Apply for NGEL Recruitment 2026 - NGEL Apply Online

  1. Visit the careers section of the official NGEL website, www.ngel.in. No other mode of application is accepted.
  2. Register with a valid, active email ID, since NGEL will not be responsible for any bounced-back emails.
  3. Fill in the online application form and upload all required documents listed above.
  4. Pay the non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 500 (General/EWS/OBC candidates) online via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Pre-Paid Card or UPI. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and female candidates are exempt from the fee.
  5. Submit the application and download the system-generated application slip carrying a unique registration number.
  6. Retain a copy of the application slip for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

Candidates should read the full text of the advertisement and agree to all conditions before applying, and can apply for only one post out of those advertised. If a candidate submits multiple applications for the same post, the application with the higher application sequence number will be considered.

NGEL Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be from universities/institutions recognised and approved in India.
  • Age, experience and qualification are computed with reference to the last date of receipt of the online application.
  • Candidates claiming a reserved category must hold a valid EWS/OBC/SC/ST/Disability certificate from the competent authority.
  • NGEL reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process, or restrict, curtail or enlarge the number of vacancies, without prior notice.
  • Posting can be at any Station/Project/JV/Subsidiary of NGEL, and all posts are transferable at the sole discretion of management.
  • If a candidate is found, at any stage (including after appointment), to not fulfil eligibility norms or to have furnished false/incorrect information or suppressed material facts, the candidature or service will be liable to cancellation/termination without notice.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • Merely submitting an application does not entitle a candidate to be called for a written test, interview, or further selection stages.
  • Candidates must undergo a medical examination at a specified government hospital before joining; the hospital's decision on medical fitness is final and binding, and no relaxation in prescribed health standards is allowed.
  • Disputes arising from this advertisement or any application submitted in response to it fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts/tribunals/forums at Delhi.
  • In case of any ambiguity due to translation, the English version of the advertisement will prevail.

CCI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility

Production (Post Code-01)

Full-time Engineering Degree in Chemical/Cement Technology/Cement Engineering/Ceramic Engineering/Materials Science & Engineering/Mineral Process Engineering/Process Engineering/Industrial Chemistry Engineering/Petrochemical Engineering; OR M.Sc. in Chemistry (General/Applied/Industrial)/Materials Science/Cement Technology; OR a Diploma in Chemical Engineering/Cement Technology/Process Engineering; OR AMIE (enrolment up to 31.05.2013), equivalent branch. M.Sc. candidates need 1 additional year and Diploma candidates need 3 additional years of experience beyond the minimum 2-year criterion.

Mechanical (Post Code-02)

Full-time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Industrial & Production/Mechatronics/Automobile/Manufacturing/Power Plant/Mining Machinery/Materials & Metallurgical/Robotics & Automation/Industrial/Thermal/Power/Production Engineering; OR a Diploma in the same streams; OR AMIE (enrolment up to 31.05.2013). Diploma candidates need 3 additional years of experience beyond the minimum criterion.

Mining (Post Code-03)

Full-time Engineering Degree in Mining/Opencast Mining/Mineral Engineering/Geological Technology (mining/geology specialisation)/Earth Resources Engineering/Mine Planning & Design Engineering; OR AMIE (enrolment up to 31.05.2013). Mandatory additional certification (as per MMR-1961): First Class or Second Class Manager's Certificate of Competency.

Electrical (Post Code-04)

Full-time Engineering Degree in Electrical/Electronics & Instrumentation/Instrumentation/Power/Control & Automation/Mechatronics/Electronics & Communication/Industrial Electronics/Applied Electronics & Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics Engineering; OR a Diploma in the same streams; OR AMIE (enrolment up to 31.05.2013). Diploma candidates need 3 additional years of experience beyond the minimum criterion.

Material Management (Post Code-05)

Full-time Engineering Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Industrial/Production/Manufacturing Engineering; OR a Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Materials Management/Supply Chain Management/Logistics & Procurement/Operations Management/Industrial Management/Inventory & Warehouse Management; OR an MBA/PGDM in Materials Management/Supply Chain/Operations.

Marketing (Post Code-06)

(A) Engineering Degree in any stream, or (B) MBA/PGDM or equivalent in Marketing/Sales/Material Management/Supply Chain/Operations Management - both require 1 year post-qualification experience; OR (C) a Diploma in Engineering/Management/Marketing, or a BBA in Marketing - requiring 2 years post-qualification experience.

Legal (Post Code-07)

Full-time Bachelor's or Postgraduate Degree in Law from a Bar Council of India-recognised College/University/Institution, with experience as an Advocate/Legal Consultant/Legal Assistant/Associate (enrolled with the Bar Council) or as a Law Officer in a bank/financial institution/statutory corporation/company/Government department. Advocates must submit a Bar Council enrolment certificate and a Bar Association or Presiding Officer's certificate confirming the practice period.

Finance & Accounts (Post Code-08)

CA Inter / ICWA Inter / Full-time 2-year MBA (Finance), with experience in Finance & Accounts in any manufacturing industry or PSU.

Experience in the cement industry is considered an added advantage for all posts. Computer knowledge is essential for all posts. Post qualification experience is reckoned from the date of issuance of the Degree/Diploma or Mark Sheet.

CCI Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates are shortlisted for Interview based on the declaration made in the application form. If a large number of applications are received for a post, shortlisting will additionally consider relevant experience, current CTC/monthly pay, and higher qualification based on the enclosed documents.
  • Where required, a Written Test or Group Discussion may be conducted for shortlisted candidates before the Interview.
  • Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents supporting their eligibility at the time of Interview; failure to do so means they will not be permitted to appear, and Travelling Allowance will not be reimbursed.
  • Candidates called for interview are eligible for sleeper-class train fare (shortest route) between their declared correspondence address and the interview venue, only if the distance exceeds 50 km.
  • Other things being equal, candidates with additional relevant professional qualifications and cement-industry experience will be given preference.
  • Candidates shortlisted after interview must undergo a Medical Examination, with reports signed by the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) of a Government Hospital in CCI's prescribed format, examined by CCI's Medical Officer before document verification. Candidates found medically unfit will not proceed to document verification.
  • Document Verification requires original documents and photocopies; candidates whose documents are not in order will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must clear every stage (including the medical examination) successfully to be adjudged suitable for selection; the Corporation's decision is final.

How to Apply for CCI Recruitment 2026

  1. Download the prescribed application form (Word/PDF format) from the "Career" section of www.cciltd.in.
  2. Fill the form (typed and printed, if possible) with accurate personal, qualification and experience details.
  3. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (see Documents Required below), along with the Demand Draft for the application fee, if applicable.
  4. Send the completed application by ordinary post in a cover super-scribed "Application for the post of ______" to:
HOD (HR),
Cement Corporation of India Limited,
Post Box No.: 3061,
Lodhi Road Post Office,
New Delhi – 110003
Important: No other mode or format of application will be accepted; applications in other formats will be rejected. Applications must reach the above address by 15 September 2026, 5:00 PM. CCI is not responsible for postal delay, loss or non-delivery.

Documents Required (Self-Attested Copies)

  • Matriculation certificate showing date of birth (age proof)
  • All certificates and mark sheets from 10th, 12th, Graduation and above
  • Caste Certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed Central Government format
  • EWS Certificate, as per DoPT guidelines, where applicable
  • Experience Certificate(s) from the employer, clearly stating date of joining and relieving
  • Latest salary slip, for candidates from Government/PSU (as proof of pay scale)
  • CTC Certificate from the latest employer, for private-sector candidates (if not enclosed, only the salary slip will be considered to determine annual CTC)
  • Aadhaar Card
  • PAN Card
  • Demand Draft for the application fee (UR/OBC/EWS candidates)

Important Conditions

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Selected candidates can be posted at any Unit/Office of CCI.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSU should apply through proper channel, or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview, or a relieving letter from their present employer upon selection.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not confer any right to be called for interview or appointment. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • CCI reserves the right to cancel or amend the advertisement and/or the selection process, and the number of positions may increase or decrease depending on requirement.
  • All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per company rules.
  • Furnishing false or incorrect information, or suppressing material facts, makes the candidature/services liable for rejection or termination without notice, along with possible legal action.
  • All disputes related to this recruitment are subject to the jurisdiction of courts in Delhi only.
  • All correspondence will be made only via the email ID mentioned in the application form; no hard copies will be sent by CCI to shortlisted candidates. Requests to change the registered email or mobile number will not be entertained.
  • Candidates with higher qualifications cannot claim any benefit on that ground.
  • No correspondence will be made with unsuccessful or non-shortlisted candidates. Rejected applications will be weeded out 6 months after the interview/cancellation date.
  • Any corrigendum or clarification will be posted only on www.cciltd.in; no separate press notification will be issued.
  • In case of any discrepancy between language versions of the advertisement, the English version will prevail.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Role

The primary responsibility of a Customer Service Officer is to source customers and increase the sustainable portfolio of the branch.

The CSO has to identify new business locations, source potential customers and support their addition to the branch portfolio. After disbursement, the employee is also responsible for following up with customers and collecting installments on scheduled dates.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of a NABFINS Customer Service Officer include:

  • Sourcing of clients.
  • Primary verification of client credentials.
  • Conducting Compulsory Group Training.
  • Data entry in CRIF.
  • Data entry in CMS.
  • Accompanying the Branch Manager for Group Recognition Test.
  • Accompanying CSE during pre-disbursement activities.
  • Ensuring disbursement.
  • Generating demand.
  • Following up for recovery and undertaking collections.
  • Remitting collections in the bank or banks.
  • Reporting demand and collection details to ABM/BM.
  • Maintaining and filing documents.

    Possession of a valid NCVT/SCVT-affiliated ITI Certificate in the relevant trade is mandatory.

Domicile: As per RRC/NCR notified criteria

RRC NCR Act Apprentice Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 15 years
  • Maximum Age: Should not have completed 24 years (as on 07.07.2026)

Age Relaxation:

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) 10 years
Ex-servicemen Up to additional 10 years, to the extent of service rendered in Defence Forces, plus 3 years, provided a minimum of 6 months' service at a stretch has been completed (further conditions not fully available in the source document)

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

How to Apply for RRC NCR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RRC NCR website: https://www.rrcpryj.org
  2. Read all instructions in the notification carefully and confirm eligibility before applying.
  3. Create a valid personal email ID, if not already available, and maintain it until the end of the entire engagement process.
  4. Register and fill in the online application form for Act Apprentice engagement against the revised slots/new trades.
  5. Submit the application online well before the extended closing date of 31.08.2026 (23:59 hrs) to avoid last-minute website load issues.

Note: Detailed step-by-step application instructions, application fee, required documents, and the selection process are available on the official RRC NCR website but are not specified in the documents provided for this article.

RRC NCR Act Apprentice Important Instructions

  • This is a centralized notification for engagement of Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for North Central Railway; RRC/NCR has been nominated as the nodal agency for obtaining online applications.
  • Applications can be submitted only online on RRC's official website, https://www.rrcpryj.org; candidature will be considered only on the basis of information filled in the online application.
  • New trades have been added to the originally published slots; the revision was notified on the official website on 14.08.2026.
  • Interested and eligible candidates can apply online against the revised slots/new trades up to the extended last date of 31.08.2026 (23:59 hrs).
  • Applicants are advised to submit their online application well before the closing date to avoid failure due to heavy load or website jam.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

Note: Apprenticeship posts (under the Apprentices Act) are not regular government jobs but are a popular no-exam entry route into PSUs and railways for ITI/diploma/graduate candidates, offering valuable hands-on experience.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2025-26 on 17th August 2026 along with the First Round of Tentative Allocation result and the final merit list PDF on the official website, ssc.gov.in. The Tier 2 exam was held on 10th April 2026, and the cut off has been decided based on the Computer Knowledge Test (CKT) qualifying marks, exam difficulty, number of candidates, and post-wise vacancies. This article covers the qualifying cut off, department-wise and post-wise final cut off marks, previous year trends, and the factors that decide the SSC CHSL cut off every year.

Direct Link to Check SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026

Tier 2 Exam Date 10th April 2026
Cut Off Release Date 17th August 2026
Result Type Category-wise, Department-wise and Post-wise Final Cut Off

SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026: Computer Knowledge Test (CKT) Qualifying Marks

The Computer Knowledge Test (CKT), out of 45 marks, is the qualifying-stage cut off for Tier 2. Candidates must clear this stage before their Tier 1 + Tier 2 combined score is considered for department-wise allocation. The typing test (for LDC/JSA posts) and the Data Entry Skill Test, or DEST (for DEO/DEO Grade A posts), remain qualifying in nature and are assessed on a maximum-error basis rather than marks.

How to Check SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026

  1. Visit the official SSC website, ssc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the "Result" section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the link titled "SSC CHSL Tier-II Result / Cut Off 2025-26" or the FRTA (Final Result and Tentative Allocation) notice.
  4. Open the category-wise and department-wise cut off PDF.
  5. Use Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F) to search your roll number or check the marks table against your department/post code.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Also Read: SSC CHSL 2025 FRTA Result

Factors Affecting SSC CHSL Tier 2 Cut Off 2026

  • Number of candidates who appeared: Higher turnout in Tier 2 generally pushes cut off marks up.
  • Difficulty level of the Tier 2 paper: An easier Computer Knowledge Test paper tends to raise the qualifying cut off, while a tougher paper lowers it.
  • Number of vacancies per post and department: Departments and posts with fewer seats usually see higher cut off marks due to tighter competition.
  • Category-wise reservation: Cut off marks vary significantly by category (UR, OBC, EWS, SC, ST, ESM, OH, HH, VH, PwD-Others) as per government reservation norms.
  • Previous year cut off trends: SSC's cut off pattern from prior cycles is a useful reference, though it is not a guarantee of the current year's figure.
  • Tier 1 performance of the candidate pool: Since final allocation combines Tier 1 and Tier 2 performance, strong Tier 1 scores among qualifiers can influence the final cut off.

IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Overview

Note: All dates are tentative and subject to change; candidates should check the official IOCL website regularly for updates. Age is reckoned as on 01 July 2026; work experience (for Law Officer and Assistant QC Officer) is reckoned as on 30 June 2026.

IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Note: The 31-page detailed advertisement does not itself carry a vacancy table - IOCL has published the post-wise and category-wise breakup in a separate vacancy annexure alongside the main notification. Figures below are compiled from that official annexure.

Reservation for OBC(NCL)/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD candidates is applicable as per Government of India directives.

IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility (Post-wise)

1. Graduate Engineer (Grade A)

Full-time regular B.Tech/BE/equivalent degree from an AICTE/UGC-recognized institution in one of the following domains: Chemical, Civil, Computer Science & IT, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, or Mechanical Engineering.

Category Minimum Marks
General/EWS/OBC(NCL) 65%
SC/ST/PwBD 55%

2. Officer (Marketing) – Grade A

Full-time 2-year MBA / PGDBA (equivalent to MBA as per AIU) with specialization in Marketing Management. General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 60% marks minimum; SC/ST/PwBD: 55% marks minimum. The specialization must be reflected on the final degree certificate.

3. Law Officer (Grade A)

Graduate degree in any discipline plus LLB, OR a 5-year Integrated LLB, recognized by the Bar Council of India. General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 60% marks in each qualifying degree; SC/ST/PwBD: 55% marks. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience (as on 30.06.2026) is required in litigation, law firms, or legal functions with private/public organizations or government, in areas such as litigation, arbitration/ADR, or drafting and vetting of legal/contractual documents.

4. Assistant Quality Control Officer (Grade A0)

Master’s degree in Chemistry (Inorganic/Organic/Analytical/Physical/Applied/Industrial Chemistry). General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 60% marks minimum; SC/ST/PwBD: 55% marks minimum. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in Testing/R&D/Quality Control in a petroleum, petrochemical, polymer, or fertilizer laboratory, and/or in an NABL-accredited lab (Chemical discipline, Lubricants/Petroleum group).

5. Diploma Engineer (Grade E0)

3-year full-time Diploma in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or Safety-related disciplines as listed in the official notification). General/EWS/OBC(NCL): 65% marks minimum; SC/ST: 55% marks minimum. Candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech, MBA, CA, CS, CMA, MCA, or Ph.D. are not eligible for this post. For the Safety discipline, an additional Diploma in Industrial Safety (minimum 1 year) is required.

Important: For the Diploma Engineer (Safety) post, PwBD candidates are not eligible, as the notification states this is a hazardous-industry role involving critical safety operations.

Common Eligibility Points

  • Candidates must produce their final degree/marksheet by 30 September 2026.
  • Qualifications acquired through Part-time/Correspondence/Distance/Online learning modes are not eligible.
  • CGPA/grade-based results must be converted to percentage as per the respective institute's official conversion formula.
  • Candidates must be Indian nationals with an outstanding academic record.

IOCL Executive Recruitment Selection Process

Selection comprises three stages: Computer Based Test (CBT), Group Discussion (GD) & Group Task (GT), and Personal Interview (PI).

CBT Pattern

Section Subject Questions Time
A – General Aptitude Quantitative Aptitude 20 60 min (80 min with compensatory time)
Logical Reasoning 15
Verbal Ability (English) 15
B – Domain Knowledge Post-specific technical/domain questions 50 90 min (120 min with compensatory time)
Total 100 150 min
  • Each question carries 1 mark; 0.25 marks deducted for every incorrect answer.
  • Section order is fixed - Section A first, then Section B.
  • CBT will be held at 83 test centers across India (city list available in the official notification and syllabus link below).

Qualifying Standard in CBT

Category Each Section (A & B) Overall Minimum
General/EWS/OBC(NCL) 40% 45%
SC/ST 35% 40%
PwBD 25% 30%

Composite Score Weightage

Component Weightage
Computer Based Test (CBT) 85%
Group Discussion (GD) & Group Task (GT) 5%
Personal Interview (PI) 10%

Minimum composite score required: General/EWS/OBC(NCL) – 45%, SC/ST – 40%, PwBD – 30%. GD/GT and PI each require a minimum 40% pass mark.

How to Apply for IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website www.iocl.com and click "Apply Online."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill the application form; use "Save and Next" to save progress at each stage.
  4. Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20–50 KB), signature (10–20 KB), and left thumb impression (20–50 KB) as per specifications.
  5. Capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone as prompted by the portal.
  6. Fill in educational, category, and other required details.
  7. Preview the form carefully, then click "Complete Registration" - no changes are allowed after this step.
  8. Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the application fee online.
  9. Click "Submit" and download/print the completed application form and e-receipt for your records.
Important: Only one application per post is allowed; in case of multiple applications, the latest one is treated as final. SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempt from the application fee; all other candidates must pay ₹1,000 + GST.

Documents Required

  • Qualifying degree/diploma certificate and mark sheets (as applicable to the post)
  • CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate, if applicable
  • Work experience proof (for Law Officer and Assistant Quality Control Officer posts) on organizational letterhead
  • Bar Council of India registration certificate (for Law Officer candidates with independent practice)
  • Birth date proof (Board of Secondary Education matriculation/higher-secondary certificate)
  • Category certificate (EWS/OBC(NCL)/SC/ST), as applicable, in the latest prescribed format
  • PwBD certificate and UDID card, where applicable
  • Valid photo identity proof (PAN/Passport/Driving License/Voter ID/Aadhaar, etc.)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer, if presently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Body

Important Conditions

  • Candidates having their graduation/diploma in combined, integrated, or interdisciplinary subjects (e.g., Mechatronics, Robotics) are not eligible for the Graduate Engineer or Diploma Engineer posts.
  • No change of category (Gen/EWS/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD) is permitted once submitted in the online application.
  • Selected candidates will be placed anywhere in India, including overseas offices, at Corporation discretion.
  • Final selection is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates, testimonials, and medical fitness.
  • Candidates must clear Pre-Employment Medical Examination (PEME) guidelines before joining.
  • Any use of unfair means, impersonation, or misconduct during the process will lead to disqualification and may result in debarment from future IOCL examinations.
  • IOCL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or alter the recruitment/selection process without prior notice.

Application Mode Online only, via www.nats.education.gov.in (Graduate/Diploma) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (ITI Trade)
Note: This apprenticeship does not carry any assurance of regular employment. AAI has no obligation to offer a job on completion of training, and the training program creates no liability on AAI for future employment or placement.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Important Dates

Event Date
Last Date of Application 16 September 2026
Age Reckoning Date 16 September 2026
Apprenticeship Training Period 12 months from commencement of the Contract of Apprenticeship
Note: Candidates should register on the relevant portal (NATS or NAPS) before applying. Only applications received through the registered NATS/NAPS portal will be considered; correspondence in any other manner will not be entertained.

AAI Apprentice Seats & Stipend 2026-27 (Northern Region)

80 Graduate Apprentices
65 Diploma Apprentices
60 ITI Trade Apprentices

Discipline-wise Seats

Field / Discipline Graduate Diploma Trade (ITI)
Civil Engineering 15 17 -
Electrical Engineering 10 15 -
Electronics 10 11 -
Computer Science / IT 15 7 -
Aeronautical / Aerospace / Aircraft Maintenance 5 4 -
Architecture 5 5 -
Mechanical / Automobile 10 6 -
BCA / B.Com 10 - -
COPA / Stenography - - 50
Computer Hardware & Networking - - 10
Total 80 65 60
Note: The number of seats is tentative and may be reduced or increased. All durations are 1 year across every discipline.

Monthly Stipend

Apprentice Type Total Monthly Stipend Break-up
Graduate (Degree) Apprentice ₹15,000 AAI Share: ₹8,850 + Govt. Share (via DBT): ₹6,150
Technical (Diploma) Apprentice ₹12,000 AAI Share: ₹6,550 + Govt. Share (via DBT): ₹5,450
Trade (ITI) Apprentice ₹9,600 Fixed monthly stipend

AAI Apprentice Eligibility 2026-27

Educational Qualification

Category Requirement
Graduate Full-time (Regular) 4-year Degree in Engineering in the notified streams, recognized by AICTE, Government of India
Diploma Full-time (Regular) 3-year Diploma in Engineering in the notified streams, recognized by AICTE, Government of India
ITI Trade ITI/NCVT certificate in the notified Trades, from an institution recognized by AICTE, Government of India

Domicile Eligibility

Only Indian Nationals who are domiciles of the following states/UTs may apply: Chandigarh, Delhi, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Leh Ladakh, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.

Passing Year & Other Conditions

  • Candidates must have passed their degree/diploma/ITI in 2024 or after 2024.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship, terminated it midway, or are currently pursuing apprenticeship elsewhere (or in AAI at the same qualification level) are not eligible.
  • Candidates with 1 year or more of apprenticeship/job experience after attaining the essential qualification are not eligible, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.
Important: A candidate applying for more than one discipline will not be considered, and such applications will be rejected.

AAI Apprentice Age Limit

Category Age Limit (as on 16.09.2026)
All Candidates Minimum 18 years, Maximum 26 years
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD Relaxation in upper age limit applicable as per Government of India guidelines

Apprenticeship Training Locations

Apprentices will be posted at various Northern Region airports and AAI offices in New Delhi, including:

Adampur, Amritsar, Agra, Aligarh, Ayodhya, Azamgarh, Bareilly, Bhatinda, Bikaner, Chitrakoot, CATC–Prayagraj, Dehradun, Farukkhabad, Fursatganj, Gorakhpur, Gwalior, Hindon, Hissar, Halwara/Ludhiana, Jammu, Jaipur, Jaisalmer, Jodhpur, Kangra–Gaggal, Kanpur, Khajuraho, Kullu–Bhuntar, Kushinagar, Kishangarh, Kota, Lucknow, Leh, Moradabad, Muirpur, Meerut, Pantnagar, Pathankot, Pratapgarh, Pithoragarh, Prayagraj Airport, Safdarjung, Shravasti, Srinagar, Shimla, Udaipur, Varanasi, and various offices in New Delhi.

Important: The allocated Airport/Station/Unit is final; no change in place of training will be entertained at a later stage. Selected candidates will preferably be posted at locations based on their registration location on the portal.

AAI Apprentice Selection Process

Selection is merit-based, with no written examination. The process comprises:

  1. Provisional selection based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination (CGPA converted to percentage per the concerned Board/University norms). In case of a tie, date of birth and thereafter date of passing determine seniority.
  2. Document Verification at the establishment office, intimated only through the candidate's registered email ID.
  3. Interview / Certificate Verification, with candidature remaining provisional throughout.
  4. Medical Fitness Certificate (from a Government Medical Officer or Medical Officer of a Government Undertaking only), to be submitted at the time of joining.
  5. Final selection and issuance of the apprentice engagement letter follow successful document verification and medical fitness clearance.
Note: Merely being shortlisted for document verification or the medical examination does not entitle a candidate to selection as an Apprentice. Reservation for SC/ST, OBC, and EWS is applicable; if candidates are unavailable in a reserved category, the seat will be filled from other reserved/general categories.

How to Apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Graduate / Diploma Apprentices – NATS 2.0 Portal

  1. Visit www.nats.education.gov.in and click the Student button, then select General Student (for Diploma/Graduate pass-outs).
  2. Click Student Registration and keep ready: a valid personal email, mobile number, Aadhaar number, qualifying/provisional certificate (PDF, under 1 MB), and APAAR ID.
  3. Verify your mobile number and email via OTP, then complete Aadhaar e-KYC verification.
  4. Fill the registration form (basic details auto-populate from UIDAI); add educational details and set a password, then submit.
  5. Verify your account via the email link sent to you, then log in and complete your profile: Basic Details, Educational Details (upload/fetch certificate via DigiLocker/APAAR), Communication Details, and Training Preferences.
  6. Preview your profile and submit it finally to receive your Student Enrolment ID.
  7. Search for establishment Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002) and click Apply for the apprenticeship opportunity of your choice.

ITI Trade Apprentices – NAPS Portal

  1. Visit www.apprenticeshipindia.org and click Register, then select Candidate.
  2. Fill the Basic, Family, and Contact details in the registration form and submit.
  3. Activate your account via the link sent to your registered email, then log in with your Registration Number/Email and password.
  4. Click Complete Your Profile and add your "About Me" and contact details — this is mandatory before applying to any opportunity.
  5. Search for opportunities using establishment code E05200700101 (Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR) and click Apply.
  6. Track invitations, applications, and contracts from your candidate dashboard; if offered a contract, review the details and click Sign to accept.
Important: Only applications submitted through the registered NATS/NAPS portal will be considered. After a successful application, the portal will display: "Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment."

Important Conditions

  • No Application Fee is charged for this recruitment.
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending interviews or document verification.
  • Candidates must sign and accept the Apprenticeship Contract on the NATS/NAPS portal immediately after joining AAI.
  • The Apprenticeship Contract automatically ceases after the stipulated 12-month period; any act of indiscipline during training can lead to cancellation of the contract.
  • During apprenticeship, candidates are governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended) and AAI's applicable policies, rules, conduct, and discipline requirements.
  • It is the candidate's sole responsibility to get their profile verified from the respective Regional Board.
  • AAI does not take responsibility for replying to candidates regarding non-selection or non-issuance of a call letter.
  • Furnishing false or incorrect information at any stage renders the candidature/engagement liable to cancellation.
  • Filling of seats is solely at Management's discretion; no claim will be entertained if some seats remain unfilled.
  • In case of any dispute, the English version of the notice and communication will be treated as valid.
  • The decision of AAI Management on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, mode of selection, or cancellation of the process is final and binding; no correspondence will be entertained.
