NTPC Limited, India's largest integrated power utility and a Government of India Enterprise, has released Advertisement No. 10/26 inviting online applications from experienced professionals for the post of Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) in the disciplines of Electrical, Mechanical, and C&I (Control & Instrumentation). NTPC has an installed capacity of over 91 GW and has embarked on an ambitious plan to attain a total installed capacity of 149 GW by 2032.

NTPC is inviting applications for 135 Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) posts - 40 posts in Electrical, 55 posts in Mechanical, and 40 posts in C&I. These are experienced-professional (lateral) positions requiring a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification executive experience, with an upper age limit of 40 years for all three disciplines. Eligible candidates hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with at least 60% marks. All three posts carry the E-4 Grade/IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 per month. The online application window opens on 12 August 2026 and closes on 26 August 2026. Posting can be at any Station, Project, JV, or Subsidiary of NTPC, and all posts are transferable at the sole discretion of the Management.

  • NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Organisation NTPC Limited (A Govt. of India Enterprise)
Advertisement No. 10/26
Posts Advertised Deputy Manager (Electrical), Deputy Manager (Mechanical), Deputy Manager (C&I) – all E-4 Grade
Total Posts 135 (40 + 55 + 40)
Minimum Qualification Full-time B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution
Experience Required Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience in the Power Sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in the relevant discipline
Upper Age Limit 40 years (for all three posts)
Pay Scale E-4 Grade/IDA, Rs. 70,000 – 2,00,000 per month (w.e.f. 01.01.2017)
Application Mode Online only, through careers.ntpc.co.in / www.ntpc.co.in

Selection Process Shortlisting/screening, followed by Written/Computer-Based Test, Personal Interview, or a combination thereof, at NTPC's discretion
Job Location Any NTPC Station/Project/JV/Subsidiary
Registered Office NTPC Bhawan, SCOPE Complex, 7, Institutional Area, Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003

Event Date

Last Date for Online Application 26 August 2026

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

NTPC has advertised a total of 135 Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) posts across three engineering disciplines. The projected vacancies indicated may increase or decrease as per organisational requirement, at the discretion of NTPC Management. The vacancies indicated include backlog vacancies.

Discipline UR EWS OBC SC ST Total
Electrical 15 4 10 7* 4* 40
Mechanical 21 5 14 8 7* 55
C&I 15 4 10 6 5* 40
Total 51 13 34 21 16 135

*As per the official notification, the SC/ST figures marked with an asterisk include backlog vacancies. Reservation for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) candidates will be as per Government guidelines, within the identified disability categories listed for each discipline below.

Identified Disabilities for the Posts (PwBD Categories)

Discipline Identified Categories of Disability
Electrical a) D, HH   b) OA, OL, Dw, AAV   c) ASD (M), SLD, MI   d) MD involving (a) to (c)
Mechanical a) D, HH   b) OA, OL, Dw, AAV   c) SLD, MI   d) MD involving (a) to (c)

These disability category abbreviations are reproduced exactly as listed in the official notification.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

A. Deputy Manager (Electrical) – 40 Posts

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline.

B. Deputy Manager (Mechanical) – 55 Posts

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Mechanical/Production with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline.

C. Deputy Manager (C&I) – 40 Posts

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Electronics/Control & Instrumentation/Instrumentation with at least 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in the power sector (Coal, Gas, Lignite) in Operation/Maintenance/Commissioning/Erection/Engineering/Energy Efficiency/Project Management/Field Quality, or a combination thereof, in the relevant discipline.

Experience Norms for Govt/PSU Candidates (Common for All Three Posts)

  • Out of the 10 years of post-qualification executive experience mentioned above (including training/trainee period, if any) in the executive cadre, candidates currently working in a Govt/Public Sector Undertaking should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in the pay scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E-3 Grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or an equivalent scale.
  • Such candidates must also provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer while applying for the post.

Relaxations for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Candidates

  • In terms of educational qualification, only pass marks are required for SC/ST/PwBD candidates to apply (i.e., the 60% marks criterion does not apply to these categories).
  • The total years of experience required will be relaxed by 2 years for SC/ST candidates.

Health Standards

Before joining, candidates will have to undergo a medical examination by the NTPC Medical Board/Officer, and their decision will be final and binding. No relaxation in prescribed health standards is allowed. Detailed medical norms are available on the website careers.ntpc.co.in; all applicants are advised to review these norms before applying.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale

All three posts - Deputy Manager (Electrical), Deputy Manager (Mechanical), and Deputy Manager (C&I) - are at the E-4 Grade level, carrying the IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000 – 2,00,000 per month (w.e.f. 01.01.2017). The notification does not specify additional allowances or gross salary figures beyond this pay scale.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Fee
General / EWS / OBC Rs. 500/- (non-refundable)
SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen (XSM) / Female candidates No fee

Offline mode: State Bank of India has been authorised to collect the application fee in a specially opened account (A/C No. 30987919993) at the CAG Branch, New Delhi (Branch Code: 00996), on behalf of NTPC. Candidates must approach the nearest SBI branch with a printout of the "pay-in-slip" available on the application portal, and use only this pay-in-slip to deposit the fee, to ensure proper crediting. The bank will issue a unique Journal Number and Branch Code, which the candidate must enter in the online application. NTPC will not be responsible if a candidate deposits the fee into the wrong account.

Online mode: Candidates also have the option to pay the fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, or Credit Card, within the online application form itself. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances; candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before paying the fee.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Post Upper Age Limit
Deputy Manager (Electrical, Mechanical, C&I) 40 years

Age Relaxation

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years
  • OBC-NCL candidates: 3 years
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years
  • Ex-Servicemen: as per applicable Government guidelines

All computations of age, experience, and qualification will be done with reference to the last date of receipt of the online application, i.e. 26 August 2026, as mentioned in the advertisement.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

In order to restrict the number of candidates for the selection process, if required, NTPC Management reserves the right to conduct a multi-stage selection process, which may comprise:

  • Application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification, percentage of marks, number of years of post-qualification experience, etc.)
  • Written/Computer-Based Test
  • Personal Interview
  • Or a combination of the above

NTPC Management also reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards or criteria as per requirement. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement does not by itself entitle a candidate to be shortlisted or called for the Written/Computer-Based Test or Interview, or to be considered further in the selection process.

Documents Required for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload all required documents while applying; applications with incomplete or insufficient documents are liable to be rejected or not considered for further process.

  • Class X passing certificate/Mark sheet and PAN Card, for proof of Name and Date of Birth (Name and DOB should appear in conformity on all documents).
  • B.E./B.Tech Degree (Final/Provisional) certificate.
  • Engineering consolidated Mark sheet/Transcript, or all-semester mark sheets clearly indicating aggregate percentage of marks in all semesters.
  • Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for conversion of CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into a percentage.
  • Caste/Disability certificate (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates), as applicable.
  • OBC-NCL certificate in the central format, for the current financial year (FY 2026-27).
  • Current-year Income & Asset certificate for EWS candidates, valid for FY 2026-27 based on FY 2025-26 income.
  • Disability certificate as per the latest prescribed Central Government format, generated online through the Swalamban/UDID portal, clearly indicating the type and percentage of disability in line with the identified disability categories for the post.
  • All experience-related documents for each organisation/company, placed together in chronological order from the first to the last/current company, which may include: Experience/Service Certificate (as per NTPC's prescribed sample format); Offer of Appointment/Appointment Letter/Offer Letter with Confirmation/Absorption Letter/Order on Completion of Training (if any); Joining Order/Letter; Role Assignment orders; Promotion orders; Transfer orders; Organization charts; Form-16; and two pay slips for every year for each organisation, to corroborate the work area/department/section.
  • NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the current employer, for candidates currently working in Govt/Public Sector Undertakings.
  • Pay-scale circular/matrix, for candidates currently working in Govt/PSUs, to verify a minimum of 2 years' service in the required pay scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 or above (IDA pay scale of E-3 Grade or above of NTPC, effective from 01.01.2017) or equivalent scale.

How to Apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted only in online mode, through NTPC's careers website. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Log on to careers.ntpc.co.in, or visit the careers section at www.ntpc.co.in.
  2. Register with a valid, active email ID (NTPC will not be responsible for bounced emails sent to candidates).
  3. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details for the discipline being applied for.
  4. Upload all required documents as listed in the Documents Required section above.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee (General/EWS/OBC candidates only), either offline via the SBI pay-in-slip process, or online through Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card.
  6. After applying online, download the system-generated application slip bearing a unique application number, and retain a copy for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be full-time, from Universities/Institutions recognised and approved in India.
  • The category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD) once filled in the online application form cannot be changed later, and no benefit of any other category will be admissible subsequently. Candidates claiming a particular category must possess the applicable year's valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/Disability certificate, in the latest prescribed Government of India format, from the Competent Authority.
  • Depending on the requirement, the Company reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or increase the number of vacancies, at any stage, without further notice and without assigning any reason.
  • Posting shall be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries of NTPC. All posts are transferable at the sole discretion of Management.
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment (or even after appointment) that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms, has furnished incorrect/false information, or has suppressed any material fact, the candidature will stand automatically cancelled, and the services of an appointed candidate are liable to be terminated without notice. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate.
  • Any dispute arising out of this advertisement or an application submitted in response to it can be instituted only in Delhi, and courts/tribunals/forums in Delhi alone shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute arising from interpretation in a version other than English, the English version will prevail.
  • It is mandatory that eligible candidates go through the full text of the advertisement and agree to all the conditions given, while applying. Any addendum/corrigendum/update relating to this recruitment will be published only on NTPC's official website.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released Advertisement No. 10/2026, inviting online applications for recruitment by selection to 7 posts across various central government ministries and the Union Territory of Ladakh administration, with a total of 34 vacancies. Posts include Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil and Electronics), Assistant Director (Engineering), Superintendent Translation (Hindi Branch), Research Officer, Horticulture Development Officer, and Soil Conservation Assistant. Eligible candidates can apply online through the Commission's website upsconline.nic.in/ora from 08-08-2026. The last date to apply is 28-08-2026 (for posts other than those under UT of Ladakh) and 04-09-2026 (for posts under UT of Ladakh). Job locations vary by post and include Noida, New Delhi, Kolkata, and Union Territory of Ladakh.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi has released Indicative Advertisement No. 10/2026 for direct recruitment by selection to 7 different posts with 34 vacancies. The recruitment includes Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil), Assistant Executive Engineer (Electronics), Assistant Director (Engineering), Superintendent Translation (Hindi Branch), Research Officer, Horticulture Development Officer, and Soil Conservation Assistant. The notification provides details regarding post-wise vacancies, pay levels, age limits, PwBD reservation, application procedure, and important dates. Candidates are advised to read the detailed advertisement available on the UPSC website carefully for post-wise educational qualifications, application fee, reservation, and other eligibility conditions before applying.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Post Essential Qualification Experience Required
Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or equivalent (AMIE Section A&B enrolled up to 31.05.2013 also eligible) 2 years' supervisory experience in design, maintenance and construction of structural and RCC works
Assistant Executive Engineer (Electronics) Degree in Telecommunications/Electronics/Electronics & Communications Engineering (IETE or Section A&B of Institution of Engineers, enrolled up to 31.05.2013, also eligible) 2 years' supervisory experience in radio aids to navigation
Assistant Director (Engineering) Bachelor's Degree in Civil or Mechanical Engineering 2 years' experience in civil engineering works (incl. harbour engineering) or maintenance/operation of cranes, diesel locos, marine engines and ancillary machines
Superintendent Translation (Hindi Branch) Master's Degree in Law (or Bachelor's Degree in Law with longer experience, per two alternative routes in the notification) plus Hindi-medium schooling/Hindi as a subject condition 2 years (Master's route) or 4 years (Bachelor's route) in judicial service, legal affairs, legal practice, law teaching, or Hindi translation/drafting of statutes
Research Officer Master's Degree in Geography/Geology/Applied Geology/Geoinformatics/GIS & Remote Sensing/Geomatics/Geospatial Technology, with Geography or Geology studied in all years at bachelor's level 5 years' experience in geographical/cartographical teaching or research involving data collection and map preparation
Horticulture Development Officer Bachelor in Horticulture Science or Bachelor in Agriculture Science Not specified in the notification
Soil Conservation Assistant BSc Agriculture/Horticulture, or BSc/MSc Soil Science, or BE/BTech Agricultural Engineering Not specified in the notification

Desirable qualifications are also prescribed for most posts; these are relaxable at the discretion of the Commission for otherwise well-qualified candidates. Candidates are advised to verify complete eligibility details, including desirable qualifications, in the official notification before applying.

Age relaxation of up to 10 years is available for PwBD candidates (subject to a maximum age of 56 years on the closing date) on posts identified as suitable, irrespective of whether the post is reserved for PwBD or not. Additional relaxations apply for Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers and Central/UT Government employees as detailed in the notification.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS male candidates: Rs. 25/- payable via Debit/Credit Card, UPI, or Internet Banking
  • Female candidates, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates of any community: No fee
  • Fee once paid is not refundable and cannot be carried forward to another examination or selection
  • Applications submitted without the prescribed fee (where applicable) will be summarily rejected

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection is made by interview, or by Recruitment Test (RT)/Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) followed by interview, depending on the post; the notification does not specify which mode applies to each individual post above. Category-wise minimum level of suitability in the interview (out of 100 marks) is UR-50, OBC-45, and SC/ST/PwBD-40. Where an RT is held, candidates must meet the minimum qualifying level at both the RT and interview stages.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th Standard certificate or mark sheet showing date of birth
  • Degree/Diploma certificate as proof of educational qualification (or provisional certificate with mark sheets)
  • Order/letter for any equivalent qualification claimed
  • Experience certificate(s) in prescribed proforma from Head(s) of Organisation(s)/Department(s)
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, plus OBC non-creamy-layer declaration where applicable
  • Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates
  • Documents for name change, if applicable
  • Certificates for age relaxation claims (Ex-Servicemen, Central/UT Government employees, etc.)
  • Domicile Certificate of Ladakh (for Horticulture Development Officer and Soil Conservation Assistant posts)

How to Apply for UPSC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the UPSC Online Recruitment Application portal at upsconline.nic.in/ora
  2. Complete Account creation, Universal Registration, and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these are common to all UPSC recruitments
  3. Fill the post/vacancy-specific fourth module for the desired post within the application period
  4. Upload photograph, live photo capture, and signature as per the specified instructions
  5. Upload supporting documents/certificates for all claims made (date of birth, category, qualification, experience, disability, etc.)
  6. Submit the application before the closing date; applications cannot be withdrawn or edited after submission
  7. Take a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference

UPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as the ID document for verification
  • Correspondence, including interview schedules, will be sent only to the registered e-mail ID
  • Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall
  • Face authentication is mandatory for candidates at the examination venue/interview hall
  • Furnishing false particulars or suppressing material information can lead to disqualification or debarment
  • Candidates already in regular government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department before applying

Candidates holding a degree or postgraduate qualification in Engineering can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and UPSC Govt Jobs available across India. Those with a background in Law can check the latest Law Government Jobs and Legal Officer Jobs for similar openings. Candidates qualified in Geography, Geology, or related sciences can browse more Research Officer Jobs and MSc Government Jobs matching their qualification. Applicants interested in agriculture and horticulture roles can also explore Agriculture Government Jobs, and those seeking postings in the region can check Union Territory of Ladakh Government Jobs for more opportunities.

The Nainital Bank Limited (Nainital Bank), a private sector bank headquartered in Nainital, Uttarakhand, with a network of 178 branches across 5 states, has released a notification for the recruitment of Specialist Officers in Grade/Scale-I, II & III. This recruitment drive will fill 41 Specialist Officer posts across 14 specialized profiles including Risk Officer, HR Officer, IT Officer, Data Scientist/Analyst, Civil Engineer/Architect, Manager-Credit, Manager-Law, Manager-Risk, Manager-Company Secretary, Manager-Security Officer, and Senior Manager posts in Credit, Forex, Treasury, and Law. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the Bank's official career portal.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Eligibility Criteria & Qualification

The educational qualification for every post must be full-time and regular, from a University accredited by UGC, or an AICTE-approved institute, or a Board recognized by the Government of India/approved regulatory bodies. Candidates who completed their education through Distance Mode, Open Schooling, Part-Time mode, Correspondence Courses, or Executive MBA mode are not eligible to apply.

Indemnity Bond

On selection, candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond with two sureties before joining as an Officer. For all cadres (Grade/Scale I, II & III), the bond amount is Rs. 3.00 Lakhs for a bond period of 2 years. If a candidate resigns, leaves, or abandons service before completing the specified period, they must indemnify the Bank for the bond costs, charges, and expenses incurred.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection is based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates who qualify in the online written test will be called for interview, and final selection will be based on performance in both the written test and interview, subject to the candidate being found medically fit for the assignment.

Online Test Pattern

  • The test is conducted only in English.
  • Each question has 5 answer options.
  • Penalty for wrong answer: Yes, 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Though the test duration is 145 minutes, candidates may need to be at the venue for about 4 hours, including time for document verification, logging in, and instructions.

How to Apply for Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 15 August 2026 to 7 September 2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Go to the "Career" section of the Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in, click "Current Openings" under the Recruitment tab, and click "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by Email/SMS).
  3. Use the "Save and Next" facility to fill the form in stages if required, and verify details carefully before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specifications given in the notification (Photograph: 4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB; Signature: 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB).
  5. Upload your scanned Left Thumb Impression (240×240 pixels, 200 DPI, 20–50 KB) and a handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 200 DPI, 50–100 KB) - text: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  6. Fill in all remaining details of the application form and click the Preview tab to verify the entire form before Complete Registration.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after confirming that the photograph, signature, and all details are correct, since no changes are possible thereafter.
  8. Click the "Payment" tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,500 (including GST) through the available online payment modes.
  9. Click "Submit" and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

All particulars mentioned in the online application - Name, Category, Date of Birth, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Centre of Examination, etc. - are considered final; no change or modification is allowed after submission.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Important Instructions

  • Signature and the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture against a light/white background, without caps, hats, or dark glasses (religious headwear allowed if it does not cover the face).
  • Candidates must produce, in original, a currently valid photo ID proof (PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Employee ID, Bar Council ID, etc.) along with a photocopy at the examination and interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid ID proof.
  • The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo ID proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must carry the original Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit.
  • Candidates found with an unclear/blurred photo or signature in capital letters on the admit card will not be allowed to appear for the exam.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall.
  • A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Guidelines for scribe/compensatory time are provided for visually impaired candidates and candidates with locomotor disability/cerebral palsy or other specified disabilities under the RPWD Act, 2016, with prescribed certificates (Appendix-I) and undertakings (Appendix-II) as detailed in the official notification.
  • The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.

Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education, or the corresponding certificate in the Navy or Air Force, after completing not less than 15 years of service in the Armed Forces of the Union, are also eligible. Such certificates should be dated on or before 31.12.2026.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Reservation

  • 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, for categories including Blind/Low Vision, Deaf/Hard of Hearing, locomotor disabilities (one/both arms, one/both legs, cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, muscular dystrophy, spinal deformity/injury), Autism Spectrum Disorder (mild), intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness, and multiple disabilities.
  • 4.5% of total vacancies are reserved for Disabled Ex-Servicemen and dependents of servicemen killed in action, in addition to the 10% earmarked for Ex-Servicemen (a total of 14.50%). First priority in appointment goes to Disabled Ex-Servicemen, and second priority to dependents of defence personnel killed in action or severely disabled (over 50% disability attributable to defence services).
  • Reservation for PwBD/XS/DXS candidates is horizontal and is included within the vacancies of the various parent categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN) to which the candidate belongs.
  • OBC vacancies are available only to candidates in the "Non-Creamy Layer"; OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to any OBC relaxation/reservation and must indicate their category as General.
  • Benefit of reservation under the EWS category requires an Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27, issued by a Competent Authority on the Government of India format.

How to Apply for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Bank's website, https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.
  2. Scroll down and click on the relevant advertisement, then download and carefully read Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.
  3. Register online under "Recruitment of Junior Associates 2026", providing your details in one sitting or saving and resuming (available up to three times before final submission).
  4. Upload your scanned photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per the specified guidelines, and capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone.
  5. Pay the requisite application fee online through debit card, credit card, or Internet Banking (fee is Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/XS/DXS, and ₹750 for General/OBC/EWS candidates).
  6. Review your application carefully before final submission - no corrections or edits are allowed after final submission.
  7. Submit the application before the last date, 31.08.2026, and take a printout of the system-generated application form for your own record (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).

For any problem in filling up the form, payment of fee, or receipt of admission/call letter, candidates may contact the helpdesk at 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on Bank working days) or lodge a query at http://cgrs.ibps.in, mentioning 'Recruitment of Junior Associate-2026' in the subject line.

  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained, and the fee paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Request for change or correction of any particulars, including category, once the application is submitted, will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute connectivity issues; SBI will not be responsible for failure to submit an application due to heavy website traffic or reasons beyond its control.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, smart watches, calculators, or any other communication/electronic devices are not allowed inside the examination premises.
  • The Bank may capture thumb impressions or IRIS scans at various stages for biometric verification; any inconsistency may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or misbehaviour during the examination may be disqualified, debarred from future Bank examinations, and held liable for criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No hard copy of the call letter (Preliminary/Main) or the "Acquaint Yourself" booklet will be sent by post; candidates must download these from the Bank's website.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and satisfactory completion of Know Your Employee (KYE) formalities, as well as the Bank's service and conduct rules.
  • Any legal proceedings relating to this advertisement or an application can only be instituted in Mumbai; courts, tribunals, and forums at Mumbai alone have jurisdiction.
  • The role requires flair for marketing and customer calls, banking, advisory, and cross-selling duties, both inside and outside Bank premises, with possible extensive outdoor travel and flexible working hours/shifts.
  • Decisions of the Bank in all matters regarding eligibility, conduct of tests, and selection are final and binding on all candidates; no representation or correspondence will be entertained.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize, or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual, or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection or insider guidance. Candidates must rely solely on information available on SBI's official career portal.

DGQA Technician Selection Process 2026

Selection is done through a Written Test followed by a Trade Test - there is no interview.

  • Written Test: Objective type, Multiple Choice Questions only; no negative marking for wrong answers; duration 90 minutes; 100 questions for 100 marks.
Part Subject Questions Marks
(i) General Intelligence and Reasoning 25 25
(ii) General Awareness 25 25
(iii) English Language and Comprehension 25 25
(iv) Numerical Aptitude 25 25
- Total 100 100

Question papers for Parts (i), (ii), and (iv) are set in English and Hindi; Part (iii) is in English only. Candidates are shortlisted for the Trade Test based on written test marks and category of reservation. The Trade Test carries 100 marks, with a minimum qualifying mark of 40. The final merit list is prepared post both tests, based on Trade and Establishment. In case of a tie, resolution is by (1) older date of birth ranked higher, then (2) higher marks in Numerical Aptitude, then Reasoning, then General Awareness.

How to Apply for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026

DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026 has no apply-online option. The application must be sent physically by Registered or Speed Post only.

  4. Enclose a self-addressed envelope (30cm x 12cm) affixed with a postal stamp of Rs. 55/- for admit card despatch.
  5. Clearly superscribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Technician (Semi Skilled) / Technician (Skilled)] AND CATEGORY [SC/ST/OBC/UR]".
  6. Candidates already working in Government Service or a Public Sector Undertaking must route their application through proper channel, with a No Objection Certificate from their Head of Office; applications without this NOC are summarily rejected without further communication.
  7. Send the complete application by Registered/Speed Post to: Controllerate of Quality Assurance (Systems), DGQA Technical Complex, Manovikas Nagar P.O., Secunderabad – 500009.

Applications received after the closing date, even due to postal delay, are rejected summarily and no correspondence is entertained.

NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), a subsidiary of NTPC Limited, has released Advertisement No. 03/26 inviting applications from experienced professionals for Manager (E-4 Grade) posts across its Renewable Energy (RE), Finance and Land verticals. NGEL, the commonly used short form for NTPC Green Energy Limited, has a presence in the renewable power and hydrogen generation business and has embarked on a plan to attain a total installed capacity of 60 GW by 2032. As an equal opportunity employer, NGEL is hiring for its Corporate offices, Stations, Sites, Clusters, JVs and subsidiaries across India.

NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL) is inviting applications for 34 Manager (E-4 Grade) posts - 28 posts of Manager – RE, 5 posts of Manager – Finance, and 1 post of Manager – Land. These are experienced-professional (lateral) positions requiring a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification executive experience, with an upper age limit of 40 years for all three posts. Eligible candidates include Engineering graduates (for Manager – RE), CA/CMA-qualified professionals (for Manager – Finance), and postgraduates in specified social/rural management disciplines, MSW, MBA, or Engineering graduates (for Manager – Land). All posts carry the E-4 Grade/IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000–200,000 (w.e.f. 01.01.2017). The online application window is open from 11 August 2026 (10:00 Hrs) to 31 August 2026 (18:00 Hrs), and there is no offline application mode. Postings can be at any Corporate Centre, Site, Station, Project, JV, or Subsidiary of NGEL across India.

  • NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

NGEL has advertised a total of 34 Manager (E-4 Grade) posts. Current vacancies have been calculated as per the existing roster position, and the total number of projected vacancies indicated may increase or decrease at the discretion of NGEL Management.

NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

A. Manager – RE (E-4 Grade) – 28 Posts

Qualification: Fulltime Graduate in Engineering (Electrical/ Electrical & Electronics/ Control & Instrumentation/ Civil/ Mechanical) with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution in India.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience in the Power Sector in a Govt Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Organization (including training period, if any). Of this, at least 4 years of working experience should be in the following areas at Renewable Energy Developers having at least 50 MW or more of grid-connected Solar and/or Wind and/or BESS Project(s): Business Development, Engineering, Contracts & Procurement, Commercial, Project Management, Corporate Planning, or Strategy.

B. Manager – Finance (E-4 Grade) – 5 Posts

Qualification: CA/CMA (previously ICWA) qualified from an institute recognised by the appropriate statutory authority in India.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (excluding articleship period and including training period, if any) in the area of Finance/Accounts in a Govt Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Organization. Candidates with knowledge of SAP, MS Office and Data Analytics will be preferred; preference will also be given to candidates who have worked with an RE Developer company.

C. Manager – Land (E-4 Grade) – 1 Post

Qualification: Full Time PG Degree/PG Diploma/PG Programme in Rural Management/ Rural Development/ Displacement/ Resettlement/ Rehabilitation/ Community Development/ Local Governance/ Local Development/ Livelihoods/ Social Entrepreneurship/ Social Development/ Social Administration/ Sustainable Development/ Development Policy & Practice/ Development Studies, OR MSW, OR MBA, OR Graduate in Engineering, with a minimum of 60% marks from a recognised University/Institution in India.

Experience Profile: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience (including training period, if any) in land acquisition/land aggregation/land management in a Govt Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Private Organization. Of this, at least 4 years of experience should be in land acquisition/aggregation/management for Renewable Energy developers having at least 50 MW or more of grid-connected Solar and/or Wind and/or BESS Project(s). Candidates with knowledge of SAP, MS Office and Data Analytics will be preferred.

Experience Norms for Govt/PSU Candidates (All Three Posts)

Candidates currently working in a Govt/Public Sector Undertaking and applying for any of the above E-4 level posts should have a minimum of 2 years' experience in the scale of Rs. 60,000–180,000 or above (IDA Pay Scale of E-3 Grade or above of DPE, effective from 01.01.2017) or an equivalent scale, out of the 10 years of post-qualification executive experience mentioned above (including training/trainee period, if any).

All three posts - Manager – RE, Manager – Finance, and Manager – Land - are at the E-4 Grade level, carrying the IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000 – 200,000/- (w.e.f. 01.01.2017). The notification does not specify additional allowances or gross salary figures beyond this pay scale.

NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

To restrict the number of candidates for the selection process, if required, NGEL Management reserves the right to conduct a multistage selection process, which may comprise:

  • Application shortlisting/screening (based on qualification, percentage of marks, number of years of experience, etc.)
  • Written Test / Group Discussion / Interview, or a combination of Written Test, Group Discussion, and Interview

NGEL Management also reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards or criteria as per requirement. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement does not by itself entitle a candidate to be shortlisted or called for the Written Test/Group Discussion/Interview, or to be considered further in the selection process.

Documents Required for NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload clear, legible, self-attested copies of the following documents at the time of applying:

  • Class X/Matriculation passing certificate/mark sheet, and a valid Aadhaar Card and PAN Card, as proof of name and date of birth (name and DOB should match across all documents).
  • Engineering/CA/CMA/PG/MSW/MBA (as applicable to the post applied for) consolidated mark sheet/transcript or all-semester mark sheets clearly indicating the aggregate percentage of marks, and the passing certificate.
  • Marks conversion formula from the university/institute, for conversion of CGPA/CGPI/DGPA/CGI/CPI etc. into a percentage.
  • Documents related to any other qualifications (pass certificate and mark sheets), if applicable.
  • Caste/Disability certificate (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates), as applicable.

  • Documents demonstrating position held/designation, work area, and nature of experience - such as Role Assignment Orders, Organization Charts, Transfer Orders, or Promotion Orders.

Incomplete, inadequately supported, or improperly arranged experience documents may result in the application not being considered during scrutiny and eligibility verification. Candidates from Govt Organizations/PSUs will also be required to produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview; if the NOC is not available at that stage, the candidate may be provisionally allowed to appear, subject to an undertaking to submit the NOC within a stipulated time or obtain proper relieving before joining NGEL, if selected.

How to Apply for NGEL Manager Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted only in online mode, through the Careers section of the official NGEL website (www.ngel.in). No other mode of application will be accepted.

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit the Careers section of www.ngel.in and locate the notification for Advertisement No. 03/26.
  2. Register with a valid, active email ID (this cannot be changed later; all further correspondence will be sent only via this email ID).
  3. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details for the post being applied for.
  4. Upload all required documents as listed in the Documents Required section above, in clear and legible format.
  5. Pay the applicable registration fee online (General/EWS/OBC candidates only) through the SBI Collect Payment Gateway using Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
  6. After submitting the application, download the system-generated application slip bearing a unique form number, and retain a copy for future reference. No documents need to be sent by post.

In case of multiple applications submitted by a candidate for the same post, the application with the higher application sequence number will be considered.

  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions recognised and approved in India. SC, ST and PwBD candidates with passing marks are eligible to apply for the post.

  • Posting can be at any of NGEL's Corporate Centre/Sites/Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries. All posts are transferable at the sole discretion of Management.
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment (or even after appointment) that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms, has furnished incorrect/false information, or has suppressed any material fact, the candidature will stand automatically cancelled, and the services of an appointed candidate are liable to be terminated without notice. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • The age of superannuation in NTPC Green Energy Limited is 60 years. All appointments are governed by the applicable service rules and regulations of the Company, as amended from time to time.
  • Any dispute arising out of this advertisement or an application submitted in response to it can be instituted only in Delhi, and courts/tribunals/forums in Delhi alone shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute arising from interpretation in a version other than English, the English version of the advertisement will prevail.
  • It is mandatory that eligible candidates go through the full text of the advertisement and agree to all the conditions given, while applying. Any addendum/corrigendum/update relating to this recruitment will be published only on the official NGEL website.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Eligibility Criteria / Qualification

Who Can Apply

Only Indian citizens can apply for the post of Canteen Attendant.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed Matriculation (10th Standard) or an equivalent examination from any recognized board, on or before the cut-off date of 31-08-2026. Candidates who can prove by documentary evidence that the result of the qualifying examination was declared on or before the cut-off date will also be considered eligible; mere processing of the result by the Board by the cut-off date does not fulfil the requirement. Candidates possessing an equivalent educational qualification must produce the relevant Equivalence Certificate at the time of Document Verification. Candidates with a higher qualification may also apply.

Documents Required to be Submitted

  • Matriculation (10th Standard) or equivalent certificate
  • Community/Caste Certificate, if applicable - EWS, OBC, SC and ST (the EWS certificate must be issued by an officer not below the rank of Tehsildar)
  • Document in support of age relaxation claimed as Ex-Servicemen/Central Government Employee, if applicable
  • Certificate in support of PwBD status, if applicable
  • Passport-size photograph (taken not before 3 months from the date of the notification, with the full face visible, looking straight ahead, plain background, and without cap, mask, glasses/spectacles or earphones/headphones)
  • Scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (thumb impression is allowed in place of signature for PwD/PwBD candidates with blindness and low vision)
  • Aadhaar card (or Aadhaar Authentication form in the absence of Aadhaar)

Incomplete applications, or applications submitted without a proper photograph, signature, valid photo ID (Aadhaar card, PAN card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter ID card, or any other photo-bearing ID issued by the Central/State Government), or relevant certificates/documents, shall be summarily rejected.

Duties of Canteen Attendant

  • Preparing tea/coffee/juice etc. for users
  • Serving tea/coffee/biscuits etc. in official meetings
  • Providing regular room service to officers/staff
  • Collecting used cups/plates and utensils from within the canteen premises and from the rooms of senior officers after official meetings
  • Cleaning crockery/cutlery/utensils in three stages - running normal water, hot detergent water, and potassium permanganate solution
  • Sweeping and washing the floor area
  • Cleaning/dusting tables, chairs and other canteen furniture
  • Cleaning slabs and the area where food is cooked
  • Any other additional duty allotted by the Canteen in-charge

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years of age as on 31-08-2026, i.e., they must have been born not earlier than 01-09-2001 and not later than 31-08-2008. This crucial date for determining age limit and educational qualification is fixed in accordance with the Income Tax Department, Non-Statutory Departmental Canteens (Group C posts) Recruitment Rules, 2015 (notification dated 18-11-2015). Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/SSC or equivalent certificate will be accepted as proof of age, and no subsequent request for change will be considered.

Ex-Servicemen (ESM) 3 years after deduction of the military service rendered from the actual age as on the closing date of receipt of online application
Central Government Civilian Employees (with not less than 3 years regular and continuous service as on the closing date) Up to 40 years of age

Age relaxation is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Application Fee

There is no application fee for any category of candidates for this recruitment.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Salary

Post Basic Pay (7th CPC) Pay Level Pay Matrix Range
Canteen Attendant ₹18,000 Pay Level-1 ₹18,000–56,900

Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 2 years, or such period as per the extant instructions of the Government of India.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Selection Process

Subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria, applications will be scrutinized and suitable candidates shortlisted for further selection, comprising Scrutiny/Shortlisting, a Written Examination, and a Skill Test. Candidates may also be required to undergo a proficiency/practical test if further required.

Stage-1: Scrutiny and Shortlisting

280 candidates (40 eligible applications against each vacancy) will be shortlisted out of all eligible applications received, based on the percentage of total marks obtained in Matriculation (10th Standard) or the equivalent exam, for the next round - the objective-type written examination.

In case of a tie based on percentage of marks, the following criteria will be applied in sequence: (1) the candidate older in age as on the last date of receipt of application will be placed higher in merit; (2) if candidates have equal marks/percentage and the same date of birth, all such candidates will be allowed to appear in the written examination, irrespective of the prescribed shortlisting limit.

Stage-2: Objective-Type Written Examination

Subject Number of Questions
English Comprehension 10
Hindi Comprehension 10
Food and Nutrition 10
Quantitative Aptitude 5
Hygiene and Cleanliness 5
Total 40 questions, 1 mark each

The written examination is of 30 minutes' duration (40 minutes for candidates eligible for scribe assistance). One mark is awarded for each correct answer, and one-fourth (0.25) mark is deducted for each incorrect answer. The standard of questions is of matriculation level. Question papers will be set in Hindi and English only; in case of any discrepancy between the two versions, the English version will prevail. There is no provision for re-evaluation or rechecking of scores, and the written examination will be held only in Bhopal, M.P. - no request for change of venue will be entertained. No Travelling Allowance is paid to shortlisted candidates for attending the written examination. Success in the written examination confers no automatic right to appointment.

Tie-breaker for the Written Examination

  1. Older candidate in age as on the last date of application
  2. Candidate with more marks secured in Food and Nutrition
  3. Candidate with more marks secured in Hygiene and Cleanliness

Stage-3: Skill Test

70 candidates (10 eligible candidates against each vacancy) will be shortlisted for the Skill Test, which will be conducted at Bhopal (M.P.) only. The Skill Test carries a total of 60 marks and evaluates the candidate's proficiency in duties commensurate with the post of Canteen Attendant, including preparation of beverages, basic food handling skills, preparation techniques, presentation, hygiene, and cleanliness.

Final Result

The final merit list will be prepared based on the combined performance of candidates in the written examination and skill test (score out of 100), and 07 candidates will be selected strictly on merit against the available category-wise vacancies. The final result will be displayed on the Notice Board of the Income Tax Department, O/o the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, MP&CG, Aayakar Bhavan, 47, Arera Hills, Bhopal 462011, and on the regional website https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in.

Document Verification

Document Verification (DV) will be conducted after declaration of the final result. Candidates must produce the relevant original certificates mentioned/submitted in the online application form, failing which their candidature will be cancelled. A waiting list will be maintained, and the next eligible candidate(s) in order of merit will be considered for appointment if a selected candidate fails to join, declines the offer, or is found ineligible at any stage.

Compensatory Time and Scribe Assistance

Scribe assistance is provided to PwD candidates in pursuance of the relevant OMs issued by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities. For persons with benchmark disabilities (PwBD) in the category of blindness or locomotor disability (both arms affected), scribe facility is provided if desired, along with 10 minutes of compensatory time. Scribe facility is also available to PwD candidates with disability less than 40% who have difficulty in writing, on production of a certificate from a Chief Medical Officer/Civil Surgeon/Medical Superintendent of a Government healthcare institution. This facility must be opted for and indicated in the online application form; requests made later will not be entertained. Eligible candidates who do not avail of a scribe are also given 10 minutes of compensatory time, on production of the prescribed certificate.

Post-Selection Requirements

Selected candidates shall be subjected to Medical Fitness, Verification of Character Antecedents/Police Verification. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere under the jurisdiction of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh.

How to Apply for ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Recruitment 2026

All candidates who wish to apply must fill the online application form available on the regional website of the department: https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in.

ITD MP&CG Canteen Attendant Apply Online – Steps

  1. Visit the regional website: https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in
  2. Go through the notification, Annexure-I, instructions to candidates, and vacancy positions carefully before filling up the application form.
  3. Fill the online application form completely and correctly.
  4. Upload a proper photograph (as per the specified format), scanned signature, valid photo ID, and relevant certificates/documents.
  5. Submit the application online on or before 31-08-2026 (23:00 hrs). One candidate should apply only once - multiple applications by the same candidate will result in summary rejection of all such applications.

Applications received in any form other than online mode - including Post, Fax, Email, or by hand - will not be entertained by the Department. Eligible candidates will be called for the tests/verification, and the date and venue will be intimated to them in due course by the authorized officer.

Important Instructions

  • Candidates already employed in the Central Government, State Government or a PSU should submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer, and the same should be mentioned in the application.
  • Any form of canvassing by a candidate will render their candidature liable to be summarily rejected at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • The Pr. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, MP&CG, has the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason, and to accept or reject the candidature of any applicant.
  • In the event of any tie (other than those specifically addressed above), the decision of the Pr. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax MP&CG (CCA) shall be final.
  • The Department reserves the right to change the last date for submission of application, publishing of shortlisted candidates for written examination, date of written examination/skill test, or publication of final result, if required.
  • Candidates' admission at all stages of the examination is purely provisional, subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility conditions. If, on verification at any time before or after the written examination, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any eligibility condition, their candidature will be cancelled.
  • The crucial date for claiming SC/ST/OBC/PwBD status or any other benefit (reservation, age relaxation, etc.), where not specified otherwise, is the closing date for receipt of online applications, i.e., 31-08-2026.
  • A person seeking appointment on the basis of OBC reservation must ensure they do not fall in the creamy layer on the cut-off date.
  • A person seeking appointment on the basis of EWS reservation must possess an Income & Asset certificate valid for the financial year 2026-2027, issued on the basis of income for financial year 2025-26, in accordance with DoP&T OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31-01-2019.
  • Candidates are cautioned that they will be debarred from the examination if they fraudulently claim SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM status or avail any other benefit. Candidature will remain provisional till the veracity of relevant documents is verified.
  • Action against misconduct: If any candidate is found to indulge in malpractice at any stage of the recruitment process or thereafter, their candidature shall be cancelled. The Department may report the matter to Police/Investigating Agencies and take appropriate action, including examination by forensic experts. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be subject to Bhopal jurisdiction, and the decision of the Department on all related matters will be final and binding.
  • For any difficulty in filling the online application form, or for correspondence/queries relating to the recruitment process, candidates may contact through the official e-mail ID: [email protected]. Any communication issued through this e-mail ID shall be treated as official communication for all purposes.
  • Any corrigendum issued on this recruitment notification will be published only on the Department's website. Candidates are advised to visit https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in from time to time for updates and information.

Engineers India Limited (EIL) Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released under Advt. No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/06 for the engagement of experienced candidates as Associate Modellers Group II on a fixed-term basis. A total of 22 vacancies have been announced across Instrumentation, Piping, EWS (Safety), Structural, Civil, and Equipment disciplines.

Candidates with a Diploma or B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) qualification along with the prescribed relevant post-qualification experience in S3D/E3D/CADMATIC or related software are eligible to apply. The online application process for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026 has started on 7 August 2026 and will remain open until 21 August 2026. The upper age limit is 33 years as on 31 July 2026, subject to applicable age relaxations.

Candidates can check the official notification details and apply online through the official EIL website at www.engineersindia.com.

Here is a quick summary of the EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026 for candidates who want the key facts at a glance:

EIL Associate Modellers Vacancy 2026 Details

EIL Associate Modellers Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification and relevant experience prescribed for the position code they are applying to, as on the cut-off date of 31 July 2026.

EIL Associate Modellers Qualification

EIL Associate Modellers - Qualification and Experience by Discipline

  • Reimbursement of out-of-pocket expenses for working beyond standard working hours
  • Coverage under the company's GPAI Scheme, as per company policy
  • Payment of travelling allowances for official duty travel outside the place of posting
  • Paid leave of 2 days for each completed month, as per company policy

All statutory benefits are subject to change as per applicable laws and rules.

EIL Associate Modellers Selection Process

On the day of selection, applications and certificates will be screened to confirm eligibility for the post applied for. Only candidates meeting the eligibility requirements in full will proceed further. The selection process will be conducted at EIL's Delhi, Gurugram, Chennai, Kolkata and Vadodara offices for position codes A1 to F2. Candidates must report at 08:00 AM; the exact date and venue will be intimated separately by email. Depending on the number of candidates, the process may extend up to 08:00 PM and, if required, continue the next day, in which case candidates must arrange their own stay. Only candidates who have registered online and report with a printout bearing a valid registration number will be considered.

How to Apply for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026

EIL Associate Modellers Apply Online - Steps

  1. Visit the career link on the EIL website: www.engineersindia.com and complete the online registration.
  2. Read all instructions given on the website carefully before proceeding.
  3. Fill in the online form with correct details. Round off percentage of marks to the lower whole number (e.g., 60.9% becomes 60%) and CGPA to the lower decimal (e.g., 6.95 becomes 6.9).
  4. Keep scanned copies ready before starting registration: a recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, up to 75 KB) and a signature (JPG/JPEG, up to 25 KB).
  5. There is no need to post a printed application. Instead, take 6 printouts of the completed online application form, affix a colour photograph on each, and carry them to the selection process.
  6. Note that the cut-off date for post-qualification relevant experience and upper age limit is 31 July 2026.

A candidate can apply for only one position under this advertisement; if multiple applications are submitted, the latest one is considered final and older ones are rejected without notice.

Documents Required at the Time of Selection

  • 6 copies of the duly filled and submitted online application form with a recent colour photograph affixed
  • Valid photo ID issued by the Government of India (Driving Licence/PAN Card/Passport/Voter ID/Aadhar Card) - original
  • Proof of date of birth - Matriculation/Class X certificate or Birth Certificate - original
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Matriculation/Class X/HSC/Degree/Post-Graduation) - original
  • Proof of norms used to convert CGPA/OGPA/CPI to percentage, where applicable
  • Experience certificates for all declared experience, showing date of joining, date of separation and nature of work - original
  • Supporting documents such as offer letter, confirmation order, pay slips, PF statement, ESI card and bank statement, if demanded
  • SC/ST, OBC (NCL), EWS or Disability certificate in the prescribed format, if applicable - original
  • Discharge certificate and related proforma for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable
  • No Objection Certificate for candidates currently working in/under a Central/State/Autonomous Body, if applicable

Candidates unable to produce a required original document to meet eligibility will not be considered for further selection.

Terms and Conditions

  • The engagement is purely on a fixed-term basis for a period of 2 years and will terminate automatically on expiry unless ended earlier.
  • Candidates may be required to work anywhere in India and abroad, depending on requirement.
  • Selected candidates will be allowed to join only if found medically fit, and are required to join immediately.
  • No claim for regular appointment in EIL will be entertained by virtue of having worked on a fixed-term basis.
  • Candidates must make their own arrangements for travel and stay; no allowances are paid for the selection process.

  • Any amendment, clarification or corrigendum will be published only on the EIL website; no separate press notification will be issued.

Direct Link to Download SBI SCO Admit Card 2026

How to Download SBI SCO Law Officer Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official SBI website at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Click on "Join SBI" and then select "Current Openings" from the homepage.
  3. Find the link for "Recruitment of Specialist Cadre Officer (Assistant Manager (Law) / Deputy Manager (Law)) On Regular Basis (Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/02)".

  • Carry the admit card and a valid original photo ID entry may be denied without both.
  • No electronic devices, including mobile phones, smartwatches, or calculators, are permitted inside the exam hall.

  • Keep the admit card safe after the exam, as it may be required again at the interview stage.

SBI SCO Selection Process 2026

State Bank of India (SBI) has released Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16 for recruitment of Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) in the clerical cadre, popularly searched as SBI Clerk Recruitment 2026. This is a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST/OBC backlog vacancies only - it is not open to General/Unreserved or EWS candidates. A total of 1538 vacancies (SC: 207, ST: 1219, OBC: 112) are available across 21 states/UTs. Graduates aged 20 to 28 years (as on 01.04.2026) belonging to SC, ST, or OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) categories can apply online between 07.08.2026 and 27.08.2026. Selection involves an online Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and a Local Language Proficiency Test where applicable. The Preliminary Exam is tentatively scheduled for September 2026, and the Main Exam for October/November 2026.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility

Who Can Apply

This drive is open only to candidates belonging to the SC, ST, and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) categories against backlog vacancies. General/UR and EWS category candidates are not eligible to apply under this specific advertisement.

Educational Qualification (As on 31.12.2026)

  • Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government.
  • Candidates with an Integrated Dual Degree (IDD) certificate must ensure the date of passing the IDD is on or before 31.12.2026.
  • Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed by 31.12.2026, if provisionally selected.
  • Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education (or equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate), after completing at least 15 years of service, are also eligible.

Who Is NOT Eligible

  • Candidates currently working in SBI's Clerical cadre.
  • Candidates previously employed in SBI who resigned while in the clerical cadre.
  • Candidates against whom there is an adverse report regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude.
  • OBC candidates falling under the "Creamy Layer."

PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities)

The post is identified as suitable for candidates with Blindness/Low Vision, Deafness/Hard of Hearing, specified locomotor disabilities (One/Both Arms or Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy, Spinal Deformity/Injury without associated neurological dysfunction), Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness, and Multiple Disabilities involving the above. PwBD candidates apply under their respective parent category (SC/ST/OBC) as there is no horizontal PwBD reservation in this drive; a valid Disability Certificate on the prescribed format, dated on or before the last date of registration, is required to avail concessions such as scribe facility and compensatory time.

Ex-Servicemen (XS)

Candidates must meet the definition of Ex-Serviceman as per Government of India, Ministry of Home Affairs Notification No. 36034/5/85/Estt(SCT) dated 27th October 1986 (as amended). Disabled Ex-Servicemen, dependents of servicemen killed in action, and Territorial Army Personnel (w.e.f. 15.11.1986) are covered under specific conditions detailed in the official notification, including submission of the applicable Proforma (A, B, C, or D) as relevant to their service status.

Note on syllabus: The official notification specifies the names of the test sections, number of questions, marks, and duration for each phase, but it does not publish a topic-wise syllabus. Wherever this article lists sub-topics for a section, it is clearly marked as a general guide and not an officially notified syllabus. If a detail is not available in the notification, this article states that explicitly instead of assuming it.

SBI Junior Associate Exam Pattern 2026

The selection process has three stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and (where applicable) a Local Language Proficiency Test. Both online tests carry negative marking of 1/4th mark for every wrong answer.

Phase I: Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Prelims is an objective test of 100 marks and 1 hour total duration, split into three separately timed sections. There is no sectional cut-off, but the Bank shortlists candidates for Mains based on aggregate marks (approximately 10 times the number of vacancies per category, subject to availability).

S.No. Test Name Medium of Exam No. of Questions Max. Marks Duration
1 English Language English 30 30 20 minutes
2 Numerical Ability English/Hindi (as per state) 35 35 20 minutes
3 Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as per state) 35 35 20 minutes
Total 100 100 1 Hour

Phase II: Main Examination Pattern

The Main Exam is an objective test of 200 marks over 2 hours 40 minutes, with four separately timed sections. Only the aggregate marks obtained in the Main Examination are used to prepare the final merit list Prelims marks are not added at this stage.

S.No. Test Name Medium of Exam No. of Questions Max. Marks Duration
1 General/Financial Awareness English/Hindi (as per state) 50 50 35 minutes
2 General English English 40 40 35 minutes
3 Quantitative Aptitude English/Hindi (as per state) 50 50 45 minutes
4 Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude English/Hindi (as per state) 50 60 45 minutes
Total 190 200 2 Hr. 40 min.

Candidates must score minimum qualifying marks on aggregate, as decided by the Bank; there are no individual sectional qualifying marks, and sectional marks are not maintained separately.

Phase III: Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

Provisionally selected candidates who have not studied the specified local language of the applied state in Class 10 or 12 must appear for the LLPT after Main Exam qualification but before joining. Candidates who submit a 10th/12th mark sheet showing the local language as a subject are exempted from this test.

S.No. Test Pattern Section No. of Passages No. of Questions Max. Marks
1 Non-Verbal Test Objective 3 15 15
1 Non-Verbal Test Subjective 3 15 15
2 Verbal Test - - 20

Candidates who fail to qualify the LLPT will not be offered appointment.

SBI Junior Associate Syllabus 2026 (Section-wise Guide)

The notification does not release a detailed, topic-wise syllabus it only names the test sections shown above. Based on the officially named sections, the following are the broad areas typically covered under each section for this kind of clerical-cadre banking exam. Treat this as a general study guide, not an official syllabus document.

Prelims Sections

  • English Language: Reading comprehension, cloze test, para jumbles, error detection, fill in the blanks, vocabulary-based questions.
  • Numerical Ability: Simplification, number series, quadratic equations, data interpretation, arithmetic problems (percentage, profit & loss, average, ratio, time & work, simple/compound interest).
  • Reasoning Ability: Puzzles, seating arrangement, syllogism, inequality, coding-decoding, blood relations, direction sense, alphanumeric series.

Mains Sections

  • General/Financial Awareness: Current affairs, banking and financial awareness, static general knowledge.
  • General English: Comprehension, grammar, vocabulary, sentence correction, and para-based questions at a slightly higher difficulty than Prelims.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Data interpretation, data sufficiency, arithmetic word problems, number series, simplification/approximation.
  • Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude: Advanced puzzles and seating arrangement, logical reasoning, plus basic computer knowledge (fundamentals, MS Office, internet, and banking-related computer terms).

  • Visit the official SBI careers page: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
  • Locate and open the "Special Recruitment drive for Junior Associates 2026" link.
  • Download and carefully read Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16.
  • Register online with a valid email ID and mobile number.
  • Fill in the application form and upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) using debit card, credit card, or internet banking.
  • Submit the form and save/print the system-generated application form for your records (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).

Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for vacancies in one State/UT only and can appear for the test only once under this recruitment project.
  • There is no provision for Inter-Circle or Inter-State transfer, except intra-state transfer between Delhi Circle & Lucknow Circle (Uttar Pradesh) and between Mumbai Metro Circle & Maharashtra Circle (Maharashtra), subject to the Bank's extant guidelines.
  • No changes or corrections to submitted application particulars, including category, will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, and similar devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination premises.
  • A wait list of up to 50% of vacancies (state-category wise) will be maintained and released quarterly, valid for one year from the date of declaration of the final result.
  • SBI reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • SBI has clarified it does not endorse any external coaching platform or consultancy claiming to guarantee selection; candidates should rely only on the official career portal.

SBI Specialist Cadre Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection for all 10 posts across the three advertisements is based on Shortlisting and Interview:

  • Shortlisting: Merely meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to an interview call. The shortlisting committee decides the parameters, and the Bank's decision on which candidates to call is final.
  • Interview: Carries 100 marks; qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.
  • Merit List: Prepared in descending order of interview scores; candidates tied at the cut-off are ranked by age (older candidates ranked higher).
  • CTC Negotiation (contractual posts only - DVP, DCTO, VP): Conducted with candidates in merit order, one by one. If a selected candidate does not agree to the negotiated CTC, they are treated as a Voluntary Exit, and the next candidate in the merit list is called.
  • Final Selection: Top-most candidates in the merit list (with successful CTC negotiation, for contractual posts) are finally selected.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for BoB Recruitment 2026 may comprise Application Scrutiny, an Online Test, a Psychometric Test, and/or a Group Discussion and Personal Interview, as decided by the Bank for each post.

  • Online Test (if conducted): Tentative structure includes Reasoning (25 questions/25 marks), English Language (25 questions/25 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions/25 marks), and Professional Knowledge (75 questions/150 marks), for a total of 150 questions/225 marks in 150 minutes. Reasoning, English Language, and Quantitative Aptitude sections are qualifying in nature; only Professional Knowledge marks count toward the final result. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Psychometric Test/Personal Interview (PI): Conducted to assess personality, communication, problem-solving ability, efficiency, and willingness to work in any part of the country. The minimum qualifying marks for PI are 60% for General & EWS category and 55% for other reserved categories.
  • Final Selection: Based on combined scores from the Online Test and/or PI, subject to vacancies available under the respective category.

  • No Objection Certificate from current employer (for candidates serving in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Bank)

  • Any other relevant document in support of eligibility
