How to Apply for BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website at www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and go to the Career section → Current Opportunities.
  2. Register online using a valid personal email ID and mobile number, which must be kept active till completion of the recruitment process.
  3. Fill in the online application form carefully, upload a scanned photograph, signature, and supporting documents such as Date of Birth proof, qualification certificates, experience letters, and category certificates, as per the specifications given in the notification.
  4. Verify all details before submitting, since no changes are permitted after clicking the Submit button.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  6. On successful payment, download and retain a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for future reference.

BoB Professionals Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply, as selected candidates will be posted at the Bank's absolute discretion.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 12 months.
  • Candidates selected for JMG/S-I posts must execute a service bond to serve for a minimum of 3 years or pay an amount equivalent to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 2 lakh) if they leave before completing three years.
  • Candidates selected for MMG/S-II, MMG/S-III, and SMG/S-IV posts must execute a similar service bond, with the payable amount not exceeding Rs. 3 lakh.
  • Change of category is not permitted at any stage after registration of the online application.

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) conducts the RRB JE Exam to select candidates for Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) posts across Indian Railways. The RRB JE 2026 recruitment cycle (CEN 04/2026) was announced in August 2026, with the online application window opening on 14 August 2026. Knowing the RRB JE Syllabus 2026 and exam pattern together is essential before starting preparation, as the exam is conducted in two stages (CBT 1 and CBT 2) that test different subjects and difficulty levels. This article covers the subject-wise syllabus, exam pattern, selection process, and preparation tips for RRB JE.

RRB JE Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026 - Overview

Feature Details
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
Exam Name RRB JE Exam
Posts Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA)
Recruitment Cycle CEN 04/2026 (application window opened 14 August 2026)
Selection Stages CBT 1, CBT 2, Document Verification, Medical Examination
Total Questions CBT 1 – 100; CBT 2 – 150
Total Marks CBT 1 – 100; CBT 2 – 150
Duration CBT 1 – 90 minutes; CBT 2 – 120 minutes
Marking Scheme 1 mark per correct answer
Negative Marking 1/3 mark deducted per wrong answer
Official Website https://rrbcdg.gov.in/

RRB JE Selection Process 2026

Candidates are selected through the following stages, in order:

  1. First Stage CBT (CBT 1): A screening-level test covering Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, and General Science. Only candidates who clear CBT 1 (based on RRB's normalization and cut-off process) move to CBT 2.
  2. Second Stage CBT (CBT 2): A more technical test covering General Awareness, Physics & Chemistry, Basics of Computer Applications, Basics of Environment & Pollution Control, and Technical Abilities specific to the candidate's engineering discipline. Final merit is based on CBT 2 performance.
  3. Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates, based on CBT 2 merit and category-wise vacancies, are called to verify educational certificates, category certificates, and other documents.
  4. Medical Examination (ME): Candidates who clear DV undergo a medical fitness test as per the medical standards prescribed for the specific post.

Note: CBT 1 is only a qualifying/screening stage and its marks are not typically counted toward final merit, which is based on CBT 2. This is consistent with the pattern description in the reference sources; candidates should confirm the exact merit-weightage rule in the official notification.

Also Read: RRB JE 04/2026 Recruitment 2026 Notification

RRB JE Exam Pattern 2026

RRB JE CBT 1 Exam Pattern

Subject No. of Questions Marks
Mathematics 30 30
General Intelligence & Reasoning 25 25
General Awareness 15 15
General Science 30 30
Total 100 100

CBT 1 consists of 100 objective-type MCQs, to be completed in 90 minutes. Each correct answer carries 1 mark, and 1/3 mark is deducted for every wrong answer.

RRB JE CBT 2 Exam Pattern

Subject No. of Questions Marks
General Awareness 15 15
Physics & Chemistry 15 15
Basics of Computer Applications 10 10
Basics of Environment & Pollution Control 10 10
Technical Abilities (branch-specific) 100 100
Total 150 150

CBT 2 consists of 150 objective-type MCQs, to be completed in 120 minutes (2 hours), with the same marking scheme of 1 mark per correct answer and 1/3 mark negative marking per wrong answer. Since Technical Abilities alone accounts for 100 of the 150 marks in CBT 2, it carries the largest share of this stage this is a direct read of the marks distribution above, not a separate weightage claim from any source.

RRB JE Syllabus 2026

The RRB JE Syllabus is divided into the CBT 1 syllabus (screening-level, common to all candidates) and the CBT 2 syllabus (common sections plus a Technical Abilities section specific to the candidate's engineering branch). The detailed topic-wise breakdown is given below.

1. Mathematics (CBT 1)

  • Number systems
  • BODMAS
  • Decimals
  • Fractions
  • LCM and HCF
  • Ratio and Proportion
  • Percentages
  • Mensuration
  • Time and Work
  • Time and Distance
  • Simple and Compound Interest
  • Profit and Loss
  • Algebra
  • Geometry
  • Trigonometry
  • Elementary Statistics
  • Square Root
  • Age Calculations
  • Calendar & Clock
  • Pipes & Cistern

2. General Intelligence and Reasoning (CBT 1)

  • Analogies
  • Alphabetical and Number Series
  • Coding and Decoding
  • Mathematical operations
  • Relationships
  • Syllogism
  • Jumbling
  • Venn Diagram
  • Data Interpretation and Sufficiency
  • Conclusions and Decision-Making
  • Similarities and Differences
  • Analytical reasoning
  • Classification
  • Directions
  • Statement – Arguments and Assumptions

3. General Awareness (CBT 1 and CBT 2 – common)

  • Current affairs
  • Indian Geography
  • Culture and history of India, including the freedom struggle
  • Indian Polity and Constitution
  • Indian Economy
  • Environmental issues concerning India and the world, sports, and general scientific and technological developments

4. General Science (CBT 1)

  • Physics, Chemistry, and Life Sciences up to 10th standard CBSE syllabus

5. Physics and Chemistry (CBT 2)

Questions are set from 12th-standard-level Physics and Chemistry, carrying 15 questions in CBT 2.

6. Basics of Computer Applications (CBT 2)

  • Computers and their architecture
  • Input & Output devices
  • MS Office
  • Storage devices
  • Operating Systems
  • Internet and Email
  • Websites & Web Browsers
  • Networking
  • Computer Virus

7. Basics of Environment and Pollution Control (CBT 2)

  • Basics of Environment
  • Adverse effects of environmental pollution
  • Pollution control strategies
  • Types of pollution
  • Waste Management
  • Global warming
  • Acid rain
  • Ozone depletion

8. Technical Abilities (CBT 2 – branch-specific)

This section carries 100 of the 150 marks in CBT 2 and is based on the engineering branch/discipline the candidate has applied for. The branch-wise syllabus is given below.

(A) Civil & Allied Engineering

Topic Sub-topics
Engineering Mechanics Force, moment, force systems, equilibrium, friction, centroid, centre of gravity, simple machines
Building Construction Substructure and superstructure components; load-bearing, framed, and composite structures
Building Materials Masonry materials, timber, glass, plastic, aluminum, steel, bitumen, PVC, CPVC, PPF
Substructure Construction Job layout, earthwork, foundation types, dewatering, coffer dams, bearing capacity
Superstructure Construction Masonry types, cavity walls, doors/windows, stairs, lifts, escalators, scaffolding, shoring
Building Finishes Floor finishes, wall plastering/pointing/painting, roofing materials including RCC
Building Maintenance Cracks and repairs (grouting, guniting, epoxy), settlement causes/remedies, re-baring
Building Drawing Conventions, planning principles, byelaws, plan/elevation/section drawings, perspective drawing
Concrete Technology Cement grades, aggregates, mix design, testing, quality control, admixtures, special concretes
Surveying Chain survey, compass survey, leveling, contouring, plane table, theodolite, tacheometry, curves, aerial survey, remote sensing
Computer-Aided Design CAD software (AutoCAD, Auto Civil, 3D Max), plan/elevation/section generation, 3D views
Geotechnical Engineering Soil properties, permeability, seepage, shear strength, bearing capacity, compaction, site investigation
Hydraulics Fluid properties, hydrostatic pressure, pipe flow, open channel flow, flow-measuring devices, hydraulic machines
Irrigation Engineering Hydrology, reservoir planning, percolation tanks, diversion headworks
Mechanics of Structures Stress, strain, shear force, bending moment, moment of inertia, trusses, strain energy
Theory of Structures Direct and bending stresses, slope/deflection, fixed and continuous beams, moment distribution, columns
Design of Concrete Structures Working stress and limit state methods, reinforced sections, shear, bond, development length, T-beams, footings
Design of Steel Structures Sections, steel grades, IS codes, connections, tension/compression members, trusses, beams, columns
Transportation Engineering Railway engineering, bridge engineering, tunnel engineering
Highway Engineering Road investigation, geometric design, pavement construction, traffic engineering, drainage, maintenance
Environmental Engineering Pollution control, water supply, sewage, solid waste management, sanitation, plumbing
Advanced Construction Techniques Fibers, plastics, advanced concreting, formwork, prefabrication, earth-moving machinery
Estimating and Costing Approximate and detailed estimates, measurement modes, rate analysis
Contracts and Accounts Types of engineering contracts, tender documents, payment, specifications

(B) Electrical & Allied Engineering

Topic Sub-topics
Basic Concepts Resistance, inductance, capacitance, current, voltage, power, energy, units
Circuit Law Kirchhoff's laws, network theorems
Magnetic Circuit Flux, mmf, reluctance, magnetic materials, electromagnetic induction, self/mutual induction
AC Fundamentals Instantaneous/peak/RMS/average values, sinusoidal waveforms, series/parallel AC circuits, resonance, poly-phase systems, star/delta connection
Measurement and Instruments Power/energy measurement, wattmeter methods, frequency/phase measurement, ammeters, voltmeters, multimeters, Megger, AC bridges, CRO, CT, PT
Electrical Machines DC machines, transformers (construction, equivalent circuit, tests, efficiency), 3-phase induction motors, single-phase motors
Synchronous Machines EMF generation, armature reaction, voltage regulation, parallel operation, synchronizing
Generation, Transmission & Distribution Power stations, load factor, tariffs, faults, switchgear, protection, Buchholz relay, Merz-Price system, lightning arresters, cables
Estimation and Costing Lighting scheme estimation, electric installation, IE rules, earthing practices
Utilization of Electrical Energy Illumination, electric heating, welding, electroplating, electric drives and motors
Basic Electronics Diodes, transistors (BJT, JFET), simple circuits using these devices

(C) Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering

Topic Sub-topics
Electronic Components & Materials Conductors, semiconductors, insulators, magnetic materials, cells, batteries, relays, switches, MCBs, connectors
Electronic Devices and Circuits PN junction diodes, thyristors, transistors, amplifiers, oscillators, multivibrators, counters, rectifiers, inverters, UPS
Digital Electronics Number systems, binary codes, Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational/sequential circuits, A/D and D/A converters, memories
Linear Integrated Circuit Operational amplifiers, linear/non-linear applications, voltage regulators, timers, phase-locked loops
Microprocessor and Microcontroller 8085 microprocessor, assembly language programming, peripherals, microcontrollers
Electronic Measurements Measuring systems, range extension, CRO, LCD/LED panels, transducers
Communication Engineering Modulation, multiplexing, wave propagation, transmission lines, OFC, public address systems, radar, satellite communication
Data Communication and Network Hardware/interface, LAN/WAN, networking devices, internetworking
Computer Programming C and C++ fundamentals, operators, control statements, functions, arrays, strings, pointers, data structures, DBMS
Basic Electrical Engineering DC circuits, AC fundamentals, magnetic/thermal/chemical effects of current, earthing

(D) Mechanical & Allied Engineering

Topic Sub-topics
Engineering Mechanics Resolution of forces, equilibrium, friction, moment of inertia, Newton's laws, projectile motion, D'Alembert's principle
Material Science Mechanical properties of materials, classification of steels, heat treatment processes
Strength of Materials Stress, strain, factor of safety, thermal stresses, shear force/bending moment diagrams, torsion
Machining Lathe operations, cutting tools, shaper, slotter, planer, milling, gear manufacture
Welding Arc and gas welding, soldering, brazing, MIG/TIG welding, welding defects
Grinding & Finishing Process Metal removal principles, abrasives, grinding machines, honing, lapping, electroplating
Metrology Linear/angle measurement, comparators, surface roughness measurement, interferometry
Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery Fluid properties, Bernoulli's equation, venturimeters, pitot tubes, centrifugal pumps

Note: The Mechanical branch syllabus, per the reference sources, also includes Industrial Management and Thermal Engineering topics (thermodynamics laws, IC engines, refrigeration cycles) that are not repeated in the table above for brevity refer to the official notification for the complete branch syllabus.

(E) Computer Science & Information Technology

Topic Sub-topics
PC Software MS Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint
Computer Fundamentals Evolution of computers, hardware & software, Internet
C Language Structure, loops, control statements, arrays, pointers, functions, structures, unions, files
Computer Organisation Number systems, logic gates, flip-flops, Boolean algebra, DMA, instruction sets
Data Structures using C++ OOP concepts, stacks, queues, linked lists, searching and sorting algorithms
DBMS Fundamentals Data models, RDBMS, relational algebra, SQL, PL/SQL, cursors, triggers
Operating Systems (Linux) Unix/Linux architecture, file system, commands, system administration
Web Technologies Internet/Intranet, LAN, routers, HTML basics, web servers, browsers, security
Data and Network Communication OSI model, TCP/IP, transmission media, error detection/correction, Ethernet
Java Programming JVM, data types, classes, objects, inheritance, threads, applets
Software Engineering Life cycle models, requirements analysis, design principles, testing strategies, project management

(F) Printing Technology

Covers printing systems, printing materials, flexo/gravure/screen printing, printing finishing processes, image processing, design & advertising in print media, sheet-fed and web offset machines, publishing software, colour separation, plate-making methods, and printer's accounting per the branch-wise syllabus in the reference sources. Refer to the official notification for the full topic list, as this branch's syllabus is extensive.

(G) Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA)

The CMA technical syllabus covers general science topics at an intermediate level, including:

  • Measurements, units, dimensions, and errors in measurement
  • Light: reflection, refraction, interference, diffraction, polarization
  • Heat: transmission, expansion, calorimetry, latent heat
  • Sound: propagation, characteristics, resonance, Doppler effect
  • Mechanics: motion, friction, Newton's laws, momentum, gravitation
  • Magnetism and Electricity & Electromagnetism
  • Modern Physics: atomic models, radioactivity, nuclear reactions
  • Electronics and Communications: semiconductors, diodes, transistors, logic gates
  • Matter, Chemical Reactions, Acids/Bases/Salts
  • Atomic Structure and Periodic Classification of Elements
  • Chemical Bonding, Carbon and its Compounds
  • Environmental Chemistry and Metallurgy

How to Prepare for RRB JE Exam 2026

  1. Start with the syllabus, not question banks. Map out CBT 1 subjects first since it's the qualifying stage, then move to your specific Technical Abilities branch for CBT 2.
  2. Build a subject-wise timetable. Since Technical Abilities alone carries 100 of 150 marks in CBT 2, allocate proportionally more study time to your branch subjects than to General Awareness or Computer Basics.
  3. Use RRB JE previous year question papers (PYQs). This helps you understand question difficulty and recurring topic patterns across CBT 1 and CBT 2.
  4. Take sectional mock tests as you finish each subject. Don't wait until the full syllabus is done test topic-wise to catch weak areas early.
  5. Revise General Science and General Awareness weekly. These sections change least in preparation strategy but need regular touchpoints, unlike technical subjects that need deep, one-time study.
  6. Practice negative-marking-aware attempts in mocks. With 1/3 mark deducted per wrong answer, build the habit of skipping low-confidence questions during timed practice.

Other Eligibility Conditions

  • Applicants must be resident and/or registered with a local Employment Exchange within Tamil Nadu, with registration date not beyond the application's last date, except wards of Railway employees.
  • Wards of Railway employees must submit the Railway employee's Identity Card/Service Certificate (attested by a Gazetted Officer), along with UMID card and PPO copy as proof.
  • Vacancies for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are reserved trade-wise, subject to permissible disability categories and a minimum of 40% relevant disability; a disability certificate from the Central/State Government is required to claim this benefit.

ICF Act Apprentice Age Limit

Age will be reckoned as on 7 September 2026.

  • ITI candidates: must have completed 15 years and not completed 24 years of age.
  • Non-ITI candidates: must have completed 15 years and not completed 22 years of age.
  • Upper age relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates.
  • Upper age relaxation for Persons with Disability: 10 years.
  • SC/ST candidates must produce a caste certificate, and OBC candidates must produce an OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, at the time of Document Verification.

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

ICF Act Apprentice Application Fee

  • A processing fee of ₹100 plus applicable service charges (non-refundable) must be paid online.
  • No application fee is required for SC, ST, PwBD, and Women candidates.
  • No request for refund of fee once remitted will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • After successful payment (for candidates other than SC/ST/PwBD/Women), a unique Transaction ID starting with "DU" is sent to the registered mobile number and should be preserved for future reference.

ICF Act Apprentice Selection Process

  • The merit list is prepared based on marks obtained in Std X. For COVID-pass candidates in Std X, proof of the IX std mark sheet or X std half-yearly mark sheet duly signed by the Principal will be considered.
  • If two candidates have equal marks, the candidate with older age is preferred; if dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed Std X earlier is considered first.
  • Freshers exercise trade options, and trades are allotted based on merit order and vacancy availability; once allotted, requests for change of trade are not entertained. Candidates selected against benchmark disabilities are allotted only the trade permissible to them.
  • Ex-ITI candidates are trained in the trade for which they hold an ITI certificate.
  • Selected candidates must be physically fit as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprentices Rules, and must produce a Medical Certificate from a Government-authorised doctor (not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon) at Document Verification.
  • Selected candidates must execute a contract of apprenticeship; if a candidate is a minor, their guardian executes the contract as per the guidelines of the Regional Director of Apprenticeship Training, Guindy, Chennai.
  • Original Transfer Certificate for the qualifying examination (Std X/XII/ITI) must be produced during document verification.

How to Apply for ICF Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the ICF web portal at pb.icf.gov.in.
  2. Read the notification thoroughly before filling the online application form.
  3. Keep all relevant documents/certificates and a recent passport-size photograph (maximum 200 KB, jpg/jpeg format) ready before starting the form.
  4. Fill in the required details and submit the application; a system-generated registration number will be issued as the individual Registration ID, with the date of birth (in ddmmyyyy format) as the password for the acknowledgement.
  5. Pay the processing fee of ₹100 plus applicable service charges online (not applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates).
  6. Check all details carefully before clicking the submit button.
  7. Generate and print the system acknowledgement after final submission; this printout is required at the time of Document Verification.

Candidates are not required to send any documents or the application form to ICF through Post, e-mail, FAX, or by hand. All communication from ICF will be sent only by SMS (from "PBICF") or email to the mobile number and e-mail ID mentioned in the application, so candidates should maintain the same contact details until selection is complete.

Also Read: RRB JE 04/2026 Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 4098 Junior Engineer Posts

ICF Act Apprentice Important Instructions

  • This notification is purely for apprenticeship training and not for employment; no employment is guaranteed to apprentices on completion of training.
  • Imparting training at ICF confers no right to absorption in Railways after successful completion, as per the Apprenticeship Rules, 1991.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature, and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • If any declaration furnished by a candidate is found false, they will be disqualified or terminated at any stage of training without notice.
  • Accommodation must be arranged at the candidate's own cost; ICF will not provide food or accommodation.
  • Candidates selected for training will not be allowed to withdraw except for reasons beyond their control; those who wilfully remain absent are liable to refund the full training cost and stipend paid.
  • For clarifications, candidates may use the helpdesk at pb.icf.gov.in/act2026_cc/helpdesk_entry.php.

East Coast Railway (ECoR), through its Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC) Bhubaneswar, has released the ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026 notification (No. ECoR/Pers/RRC-GDCE/2026, dated 07.08.2026) for the General Departmental Competitive Examination (GDCE). This exam fills up 25% of the net Direct Recruitment Quota vacancies in Safety and Non-Safety category posts, spread across 1421 posts including Assistant Loco Pilot, Station Master, Goods Trains Manager, Junior Engineer, Technicians, Junior Clerk cum Typist, and Commercial Clerk cum Ticket Collector.

Important: ECoR GDCE 2026 is not an open-market recruitment. Only regular and eligible employees of East Coast Railway (including the erstwhile Waltair division/SCoR), excluding RPF/RPSF staff, who currently hold lien in ECoR, can apply. Candidates outside ECoR are not eligible for this notification.

  • East Coast Railway GDCE Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
  • • Never Miss an Update from OnlyJobs – Save Us as a Preferred Source on Google

ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), East Coast Railway, Bhubaneswar
Notification Number ECoR/Pers/RRC-GDCE/2026
Exam Name General Departmental Competitive Examination (GDCE) 2026
Total Vacancies 1421
Posts Assistant Loco Pilot, Station Master, Goods Trains Manager, Junior Engineer, Technicians, Junior Clerk cum Typist, Commercial Clerk cum Ticket Collector
Who Can Apply Regular ECoR employees (excluding RPF/RPSF) with lien in ECoR/erstwhile Waltair division/SCoR
Application Start Date 15.08.2026
Application Last Date 14.09.2026
Application Mode Online only
Official Website www.rrcbbs.org.in
Job Location East Coast Railway divisions - Khurda Road (KUR), Waltair (WAT), Sambalpur (SBP), MCS/CRW, ECoR HQ

Also Read: Railway ICF Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 1010 Fitter, Electrician and More Posts

ECoR GDCE Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Publication on RRC/Bhubaneswar website 07.08.2026
Opening Date for Online Registration 15.08.2026
Closing Date for Online Registration 14.09.2026

Dates for the Computer Based Test (CBT), Aptitude Test, and Document Verification will be published later on the official website and are not part of this notification.

ECoR GDCE Vacancy 2026

The ECoR GDCE 2026 notification covers 1421 total vacancies across seven post categories, distributed among UR, SC, ST, and OBC candidates as below. One post under Junior Engineer is reserved for PwBD (Locomotor Disability).

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Assistant Loco Pilot 1046 (UR-495, SC-197, ST-104, OBC-250)
2 Station Master 12 (UR-7, SC-2, ST-1, OBC-2)
3 Goods Trains Manager 284 (UR-134, SC-47, ST-24, OBC-79)
4 Junior Engineer 22 (UR-14, SC-2, ST-2, OBC-4, incl. 1 PwBD)
5 Technicians (various trades) 51 (UR-27, SC-7, ST-3, OBC-14)
6 Junior Clerk cum Typist 4 (UR-1, SC-1, ST-1, OBC-1)
7 Commercial Clerk cum Ticket Collector 2 (UR-1, OBC-1)
Grand Total 1421 (UR-679, SC-256, ST-135, OBC-351, PwBD-1)

A detailed division/unit-wise vacancy breakup (Khurda Road, Waltair, Sambalpur, MCS/CRW, and ECoR HQ) for each post is available in Annexure-A of the official notification PDF. Vacancies are provisional and subject to change as per Railway Administration requirements.

ECoR GDCE Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026, a candidate must be a regular employee of East Coast Railway (including erstwhile Waltair division/SCoR), excluding RPF/RPSF staff, currently holding lien in ECoR. Employees who have resigned or transferred out of East Coast Railway are not eligible. Employees already in the same grade/pay level as the notified post can apply for GDCE from Non-Safety to Safety posts and Safety to Safety posts; employees in a lower grade/pay level can apply for all notified categories, provided they hold the prescribed educational qualification.

ECoR GDCE Qualification

Educational and technical qualification requirements vary by post, as detailed in Annexure-B of the notification:

Post Minimum Qualification
Assistant Loco Pilot Matriculation/SSLC + ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in a relevant trade, OR Matriculation/SSLC + Act Apprenticeship in a relevant trade, OR 3-year Diploma/Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile Engineering
Station Master Degree from a recognized university or its equivalent
Goods Trains Manager Degree from a recognized university or its equivalent
Junior Engineer (various disciplines) 3-year Diploma in the relevant engineering discipline (Civil/Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics, as applicable), or B.Sc. Engineering of 3-year duration for Civil posts
Technicians (various trades) Matriculation/SSLC + ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in the relevant trade, OR Matriculation/SSLC + Act Apprenticeship in the relevant trade (trade varies by post - Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Machinist, etc.)
Junior Clerk cum Typist 12th (+2 Stage) or equivalent with minimum 50% aggregate marks (relaxed for SC/ST/PwBD and higher-qualified candidates); typing proficiency in English/Hindi on computer required
Commercial Clerk cum Ticket Collector 12th (+2 Stage) or equivalent with minimum 50% aggregate marks (relaxed for SC/ST/PwBD and higher-qualified candidates)

Exact designation-wise qualification (all 23 individual post variants, e.g. JE/Civil-Track Machine, Technician-III/Welder/C&W) is listed in Annexure-B of the official notification. Candidates awaiting final results of the required qualification should not apply. Qualification must be held as on the date of this GDCE notification.

ECoR GDCE Age Limit

  • UR candidates: upper age limit 42 years
  • OBC candidates: upper age limit 45 years
  • SC/ST candidates: upper age limit 47 years
  • Age will be reckoned as on 01.01.2027
  • No age relaxation is allowed to SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates applying against unreserved (UR) vacancies

Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

ECoR GDCE Application Fee

The notification does not specify any application fee for ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026. 

ECoR GDCE Salary

The notification does not give specific salary or pay-scale figures. It only states the applicable 7th CPC Pay Level for each post: Assistant Loco Pilot and Technicians - Pay Level 2; Commercial Clerk cum Ticket Collector - Pay Level 3; Goods Trains Manager - Pay Level 5; Station Master and Junior Engineer - Pay Level 6. Exact monthly salary/pay matrix figures are not specified in the notification.

ECoR GDCE Selection Process

Selection under ECoR GDCE 2026 follows a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by post-specific additional stages, Document Verification, and Medical Examination:

Post Exam Mode Additional Test
Assistant Loco Pilot CBT (120 min, 100 questions) Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)
Station Master CBT (90 min, 120 questions) Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)
Goods Trains Manager CBT (90 min, 120 questions) None
Junior Engineer CBT (120 min, 150 questions) None
Technicians CBT (90 min, 100 questions) None
Junior Clerk cum Typist CBT (90 min, 120 questions) Computer Based Typing Skill Test (CBTST)
Commercial Clerk cum Ticket Collector CBT (90 min, 120 questions) None
  • There is negative marking in CBT: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer. There is no negative marking in CBAT.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in CBT: UR – 40%, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) – 30%, SC – 30%, ST – 25% (relaxable by 2 marks for PwBD candidates in case of shortage against reserved vacancies).
  • Shortlisting for CBAT/Typing Skill Test is done at 8 times the number of vacancies, based on CBT merit.
  • For ALP, final merit uses 50% weightage for CBT and 50% for CBAT. For Station Master, it is 70% CBT and 30% CBAT.
  • Candidates equal to the number of vacancies are called for Document Verification, based on CBT/CBAT merit.
  • Final appointment is subject to passing the prescribed Medical Fitness Test.

How to Apply for ECoR GDCE Recruitment 2026

Eligible ECoR employees must apply online through the official RRC Bhubaneswar website. A single online application is required even when applying for multiple posts.

ECoR GDCE Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website www.rrcbbs.org.in and click on the ECoR GDCE 2026 application link.
  2. Fill in personal details and bio-data carefully in the online application form.
  3. Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (35mm x 45mm, JPEG format, up to 100 KB) and a scanned signature (JPEG, 10–40 KB).
  4. Keep scanned self-attested copies of date of birth, educational/technical qualification, caste certificate, and PwBD certificate (as applicable) ready before applying.
  5. Review all entered details carefully, then click the register button - once registered, no changes can be made to the application.
  6. Note the unique application number generated after registration and download/print the filled application in PDF format.
  7. Get the printed application forwarded by the controlling officer and upload the signed, scanned copy under the supporting documents tab (mandatory).
  8. Submit the application well before the closing date of 14.09.2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Also Read: RCF Kapurthala Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 734 Posts

ECoR GDCE Important Instructions

  • Only regular ECoR employees (excluding RPF/RPSF) with lien in ECoR/erstwhile Waltair division/SCoR are eligible; resigned or transferred-out employees cannot apply.
  • Name, Father's Name, and Date of Birth must match Matriculation/SSLC records and service records; no subsequent change requests will be entertained.
  • A valid personal mobile number and email ID must be maintained throughout the recruitment process, as all communication is via SMS/email only - no request for change will be entertained after submission.
  • Applications are liable for rejection for reasons including: missing Immediate Supervisor's certification PDF, incorrect educational qualification, overage, invalid/incorrect photo specifications, signature in block/capital letters, or incomplete application.
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates must produce original caste/OBC-NCL certificates in the prescribed formats (Annexure-C, D, E) at the time of Document Verification; otherwise their candidature will be considered under the UR category if otherwise eligible.
  • There is no separate reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) under this notification.
  • Electronic gadgets, wallets, belts, and metallic items are strictly banned inside the exam hall.
  • Any candidate found using unfair means or attempting impersonation will be debarred for life from all RRB/RRC examinations and is liable for legal action.
  • Vacancies are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil at any stage as per Railway Administration's requirements.

RRB Group D Application Status 2026: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have issued a revised notice on the application status for CEN No. 09/2025 (Level-1) recruitment. Candidates can now check their updated application status provisionally accepted, conditionally accepted, or rejected by logging in at www.rrbapply.gov.in. The revised status is being updated from August 9, 2026, at 9:00 PM (21:00 Hrs) onward.

RRB Group D Application Status 2026 - Overview

Particulars Details
Recruitment RRB Group D (Level-1 posts)
CEN Number CEN No. 09/2025
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB), Ministry of Railways
Notice Type Revised Notice on Application Status
Original Status Notice Issued July 8, 2026
Revised Status Available From August 9, 2026, 9:00 PM
Status Check Website www.rrbapply.gov.in
Status Categories Provisionally Accepted, Conditionally Accepted (with conditions), Rejected (with reasons)
Notification Date August 9, 2026

RRB Group D Application Status: Categories Explained

Candidates can now view their updated status under three categories:

  • Provisionally Accepted: The application has been accepted on a provisional basis. It is not a final confirmation, and RRB can still cancel the candidature at any later stage if any discrepancy is found.
  • Conditionally Accepted: The application has been accepted subject to certain conditions. Candidates must check the specific conditions mentioned against their application and follow RRB's instructions.
  • Rejected: The application has been rejected, and the reason for rejection will be shown along with the status.

Also Read: RRB Group D Admit Card 2026

How to Check RRB Group D Application Status 2026

  1. Visit the official RRB application portal: www.rrbapply.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your registered user credentials.
  3. Navigate to the application status section for CEN No. 09/2025.
  4. View your status: Provisionally Accepted, Conditionally Accepted, or Rejected.
  5. If rejected, check the reason for rejection displayed against your application.
  6. Save or take a screenshot of the status page for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The list of provisionally eligible candidates has been prepared carefully, but RRB reserves the right to rectify any inadvertent error or typographical/printing mistake.
  • RRB will not entertain any correspondence from ineligible or rejected candidates.
  • Candidature of all eligible/accepted candidates is purely provisional and can be cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process or even afterward if any inconsistency, deficiency, falsified record, or malpractice is found.
  • Candidates should refer only to official RRB websites for recruitment updates and must not rely on unauthenticated sources.
  • RRB has warned candidates to stay alert against touts who make false promises of selection in exchange for illegal consideration. The RRB recruitment process is fully computerized, and selection is based purely on merit.

Also Read: RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

What to Do After Checking Your Status

If your application shows as provisionally or conditionally accepted, continue preparing for the next stage of the CEN 09/2025 recruitment process as and when RRB announces it. If your application is rejected, review the stated reason; RRB has clarified that it will not respond to correspondence from rejected candidates on this matter.

Post Name Qualification
Court Manager (Group -B)
  • Candidates must have a Graduation degree in any discipline along with an MBA from a UGC-recognized university/institution in India. Knowledge of Legal Affairs and Computer Applications is desirable.
Clerk (Group-C)
  • Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a recognized university and basic computer knowledge, including operating Windows/Linux, typing, and taking printouts. Candidates must qualify the Screening Test, Written Test, Typing Test, and Document Verification. The typing test requires a speed of 30 WPM in English and 25 WPM in Hindi on a computer using Kruti Dev-10 font.
Stenographer Grade-III (Group-C)
  • Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a recognized university. They must qualify the Screening Test, followed by a Stenography Test with a speed of 80 WPM in English and a Typing Test with a speed of 40 WPM in English and 30 WPM in Hindi using Kruti Dev-10 font. A maximum of 10% mistakes is allowed in both stenography transcription and typing; candidates exceeding this limit will be disqualified.
Driver (Group-C)
  • Candidates must have passed Matriculation (10th) from a recognized board. Process Server (Group-D)
  • Candidates must have passed the 10+2 (Senior Secondary) Examination from a recognized board. Selection will be based on the Screening Test, Written Test, and Evaluation as per Part 10 of Schedule-III of the R&P Rules, 2022.
Peon, Orderly, Chowkidar,  Safai Karamchari & other Group-D Posts
  • Candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination from a recognized board. Candidates will be shortlisted in a 1:3 ratio for Evaluation/Document Verification based on 10+2 marks (85 marks) and evaluation of uploaded documents (15 marks). RSSB Final Answer Key 2026: What It Means

A final answer key is the last, legally binding version of the answer key. RSSB releases it only after reviewing every objection candidates raised against the earlier provisional answer key. Once the final answer key is published, no further objections are accepted, and the board prepares the result strictly on the basis of this document.

  • For Lab Assistant 2026, the final answer key has been issued separately for Paper 01, Paper 02, and the Geography paper.
  • For Forester 2026, a single final answer key document has been released covering the Vanpal written exam.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.

  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).
  • UPSC will review all representations received before publishing the Final Answer Key.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 - Download Link, Scorecard, and Marking Scheme

The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 on 17th June 2026, along with individual scorecards and response sheets for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025-26. Candidates who appeared in the Tier 2 exam, held on 18th and 19th January 2026, can now log in at ssc.gov.in using their Registration ID and password to download their final answer key, marks, and response sheet. The facility is available until 16th July 2026 (9:00 PM), after which the documents will no longer be accessible.

This release comes more than two months after SSC declared the Tier 2 final result on 8th April 2026, where 15,118 candidates were provisionally selected for various Group B and Group C posts. The final answer key now gives every candidate, selected or not, a way to verify exactly how their score was calculated.

Click Here: SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

SSC GD Constable Answer Key 2026 Marking Scheme - How to Calculate Your Score

Candidates can estimate their scores using the official marking scheme prescribed by SSC. For every correct answer, 2 marks are awarded. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 marks are deducted. Unattempted questions carry zero marks.

Response Type Marks

Score Calculation Formula:
Total Score = (No. of Correct Answers × 2) − (No. of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

NetworkingEnglish Proficiency (Spoken)Interpersonal skillsEffective Communication
Role Snapshot
HeyBuddy (heybuddy.chat) is hiring a full-time, in-office telesales executive in Noida for freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of experience in telesales, inside sales, or lead generation. The role focuses on handling homeowner enquiries and acquiring interior designer partners, serving as the first point of contact for homeowners by responding promptly, qualifying leads, and scheduling meetings with suitable designers, while also cold-calling interior designers across Delhi NCR to onboard them as HeyBuddy partners. This is a high-volume calling role with an expectation of making 150 quality calls per day across both pipelines. There are no sales targets, revenue quotas, or closure requirements; the primary responsibility is to consistently maintain the required call volume and ensure high-quality interactions that contribute to successful conversions. Key Responsibilities: A. Homeowner enquiries: 1. Speed to lead. Call every enquiry from our website, Meta ads, and expos within minutes. The first credible call usually wins the project. 2. Qualify on the call. Location, possession status, scope, realistic budget, timeline- and disqualify politely when a lead isn't ready. A clean 'no' beats a padded pipeline. 3. Pitch with credibility, not pressure. Explain how interior projects are actually priced and executed, and why a HeyBuddy-verified designer beats a random reference. Sell by being useful, not loud. 4. Book the meeting. Your output is a confirmed designer introduction or site visit. 5. Work the follow-up cycle. Homeowners take 3–6 months to decide. Run disciplined call and WhatsApp sequences until a lead closes or dies. Most conversions happen on the fourth call, not the first. B. Designer partner acquisition: 1. Build your own list. Designers and firms across Noida, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, and Delhi- sourced from Instagram, listings, referrals, and market research. 2. Pitch the partnership. Qualified leads, no upfront cost, pay only for introductions. Handle the repeat objections- 'we get enough leads,' 'what's your commission,' 'we tried a portal before.' 3. Screen before you sign. Qualify on portfolio, execution capability, team strength, ticket-size fit, and client feedback. Thirty good firms beat three hundred listed ones. 4. Close and onboard. Documentation, commission terms, platform onboarding- until they are live and receiving leads. C. Pipeline and loop-closing: 1. Log every dial, connect, disposition, and next action the same day. An untracked call didn't happen. 2. Nothing sits untouched beyond 72 hours. 3. Reconfirm every site visit the day before, and call after every meeting for feedback. 4. Report what homeowners and designers actually say- objections, pricing concerns, competitor mentions- straight to marketing, product, and the founders. What you're measured on: 1. Everything on this list is inside your control. 2. 150 calls a day. The one hard number. 3. Talk time. Calls ending in eleven seconds don't count for much. 4. Call quality. Reviewed from recordings- did you ask, listen, and advise honestly? 5. Follow-up adherence. Every open lead contacted on schedule. 6. CRM hygiene. Logged same day, every day. 7. Conversions, site visits, and partner activations are tracked- but they're the company's scoreboard, not a quota over your head. Who fits: 1. Fluent Hindi and working English. 2. Comfortable dialling all day- reads a room over the phone. 3. Writes a clean CRM note. 4. Prior experience in real estate, interiors, edtech, or any high-volume inside sales floor is an advantage, not a requirement.

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. Required Experience

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Airports Holding Limited: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.

Job Purpose: Firefighter is responsible for responding to aircraft and structural fire emergencies, medical emergencies, hazardous material incidents, and other emergencies within the airport premises. This role involves ensuring the safety and security of passengers, crew, and airport personnel by performing firefighting, rescue and emergency medical services.

Responsibilities

Emergency Response:

Respond promptly to aircraft incidents, structural fires, medical emergencies, hazardous materials incidents, and other emergency situations on airport property.

Perform firefighting, rescue, and emergency medical services to ensure the safety of individuals and property.

Fire Suppression

Extinguish fires using various firefighting techniques, including the use of water, foam, dry chemicals, and other firefighting agents.

Conduct search and rescue operations in smoke-filled and hazardous environments.

Emergency Medical Services

Provide first aid and basic life support (BLS) to injured or ill individuals until advanced medical personnel arrive.

Assist in the transportation of patients to medical facilities as needed.

Operational Readiness

Perform daily inspections and maintenance of firefighting vehicles, extinguishers, and personal protective equipment (PPE).

Maintain inventory of firefighting supplies and equipment and ensure their readiness for use.

Participate in routine emergency response simulations, ICAO-mandated training, and fire drills.

Maintain detailed incident reports, training records, and shift logs for regulatory audits.

Compliance And Reporting

Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations and guidelines related to firefighting and emergency response and ensure all tasks are performed following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Identify potential hazards during patrols and inspections, ensuring immediate corrective action.

Prepare and submit accurate incident reports, equipment logs, and other required documentation.

Collaboration And Coordination

Collaborate with airport operations, medical services, and external emergency agencies during incidents.

Coordinate with the Duty Manager, ATC, and airport authorities during emergency operations and drills.

Civil Aviation Authorities

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Diploma in Fire Fighting Technology or equivalent qualification.

Certification from an accredited firefighting academy is required.

Work Experience

2-3 years of experience firefighting experience, preferably in aircraft rescue and fire fighting (ARFF) operations.

SHORT ANSWERAsk questions that show you've already started solving their problems, not just learning about the company. Focus on how your unique skills will contribute to their specific goals, using details from the job posting and your resume to frame your inquiries. Your questions should reveal your strategic value, not just your curiosity.

That moment at the end of an interview, when they turn the tables and ask, "Do you have any questions for us?" can feel like a pop quiz. Most anxious job seekers just want to get through it, but this is actually your final, best chance to show them you're the solution to their problems. I promise, you can turn this moment into a powerful demonstration of your value.

ONE LINE EACH Who I am The proof What I want next say it in one breath

FIG. 02I used to ramble when someone asked what I did. Now I keep three lines ready: who I am, the proof, and what I want next. When all three stack into one breath, people remember you.

  • 01 How do I show I've already started thinking about their problems?

Frame your questions around specific challenges or goals mentioned in the job posting or throughout the interview, demonstrating youâre already in problem-solving mode for them. This shifts you from interviewee to potential partner, showing youâre not just looking for a job, but for impact. Youâre not asking what they do; youâre asking how you can help them do it better.

For example, if the posting mentions expanding into a new market, you might ask, "I noticed the posting highlighted a push into the APAC region. What specific metrics are you tracking for success in that expansion over the next 12 months, and how do you see this role directly contributing to those early wins?" This tells them you read the posting, you understand their strategic direction, and you're already thinking about measurable outcomes. It's a much stronger signal than, "What's the team culture like?" I want you to make every question a mini pitch for your specific skills.

  • 02

Should I ask about the 30/60/90 day plan?

Asking about the 30/60/90 day plan is a smart move, but only if you frame it to show how you'd execute your own plan, not just hear theirs. This question can reveal critical expectations and allow you to align your prepared 30/60/90 day plan from your Baldwin Blueprint with their vision. It's about demonstrating initiative and foresight.

Instead of "What would my 30/60/90 day plan look like?" try, "Based on our conversation about [specific challenge or project], what would be the top one or two priorities you'd want someone in this role to tackle and deliver measurable results on within their first 90 days?" This invites them to share their critical needs, and you can then connect those needs to your own Experience Accelerator and 30/60/90 day plan, which your Blueprint helps you build from the actual job posting. It shows you're not just waiting for instructions; you're ready to hit the ground running with concrete contributions.

Four rooms, four scorecards Manager Peer Partner Skip level JUDGMENT CRAFT TEAMWORK GROWTH answer the real scorer

FIG. 03An interview loop is not one test, it is four. Each person in the room is measuring a different thing: the hiring manager scores judgment, the peer scores craft, the cross functional partner scores collaboration, and the skip level scores trajectory. Speak to what each one is actually grading. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What's a question that shows I'm thinking long-term?

A question that shows you're thinking long-term connects your potential contributions to the company's broader strategic goals, positioning you as an investment, not just a hire. This demonstrates ambition and a desire to grow with the company, making your candidacy more compelling. Itâs about signaling that you see a future with them.

Consider asking, "Beyond the immediate responsibilities, what are the biggest strategic shifts or initiatives this team expects to navigate in the next 18 to 24 months, and how does this role evolve to support those changes?" This shows you're looking beyond the immediate tasks and are interested in the trajectory of the company and your potential role within it. It's a question that conveys seriousness about your career and their future, which hiring managers appreciate. It pushes past the tactical and into the strategic, which is where true impact lies.

THEY ASK Any questions for us? YOU ASK Where do projects stall before they ship? this is the interview too

FIG. 04The questions you ask are part of the interview, not a polite afterthought. When they ask if you have questions, skip the perks and ask about the real work: what success looks like in 90 days, where projects stall, who owns the roadmap. The questions you ask reveal how you think, so make them sharp.

  • 04 Is there anything I should absolutely NOT ask?

Avoid asking questions that are easily answered by a quick search of the company website or questions solely focused on benefits, salary, or vacation time at this stage. These types of questions signal a lack of preparation or a self-serving focus, detracting from your professional image. Your final questions should reinforce your value, not raise doubts.

I also tell people to avoid asking questions that are overly generic or could apply to any company, like "What do you like most about working here?" While it's okay to build rapport, your final questions are for demonstrating strategic fit. Save the generic questions for networking calls, not the interview's closing act. Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to ask what you want to know, not what *they* need to hear. Your Baldwin Blueprint helps you identify their core needs directly from the job posting, so your questions can be laser focused on those.

  • 05

How do I ask a question that makes me stand out?

Ask a question that directly references a detail from your resume or the job posting, then connect it to a strategic signal or an Account Map insight from your Baldwin Blueprint. This type of question makes you memorable because it's specific, personalized, and demonstrates deep preparation. It shows you've done your homework and understand their world.

For example, if your resume highlights a specific project management success, and the job posting emphasizes improving project timelines, you could ask: "Given my experience leading the [Project Name] initiative, where we reduced delivery times by 15%, what are the current bottlenecks in your project pipeline that you envision this role specifically addressing?" This isn't just a question; it's a subtle reminder of your relevant achievements and a direct offer to solve their problems. Itâs about making a direct link between your past success and their future needs. This is the difference between a good candidate and the one they can't stop thinking about.

Before

After

Based on my research into your Q3 earnings call, where you discussed streamlining supply chain logistics, what specific data sources or key stakeholders would be critical for me to engage with in my first 30 days to begin mapping out an optimization strategy for that area?

Interview Questions: Impact vs. Inquiry What most people do What actually works Ask about team culture or company benefits. Ask how your specific skills solve their problems. Ask for a job description summary. Refer to a specific point from the job posting or their website. Ask generic questions from a list. Craft questions that lead to an offer, not just information. Ask questions that show you're curious. Ask questions that show you're already contributing. Wait to be told what to do. Propose how you'll make an immediate impact.

The takeaways

  • 01Ask questions that solve problems, not just gather info.
  • 02Reference the job posting and your resume directly.
  • 03Frame questions to reveal your strategic value.
  • 04Use your 30/60/90 plan to guide your questions.

Questions people ask

What if I don't have any questions left after our conversation?

It's rare that you won't have any questions if you're truly engaged, but if it happens, you can say, "You've been incredibly thorough, and I feel I have a strong understanding of the role and team. I'm confident I can contribute significantly." Then, pivot to reiterating your interest and fit. You can also offer to follow up if new questions arise.

Is this just a fancy cover letter? What does Baldwin Blueprint actually do?

No, it's much more. A cover letter is static. Baldwin Blueprint turns the actual job posting and your resume into a living 12 page strategic Blueprint you walk in with. It includes an Impact Memo, an Account Map, Strategic Signals, an Experience Accelerator, and a 30/60/90 day plan tailored specifically to that role. It's built from the actual posting, and the first draft is free, no card required. It gives you concrete, specific content for every stage of the interview, including the questions you ask.

How many questions should I ask?

Aim for 2 to 3 strong, impactful questions. Quality over quantity. You want to leave them thinking about your insights, not just how many questions you had. If your questions are strategic and well-researched, you won't need many to make a lasting impression. Focus on the ones that highlight your unique value and understanding of the role.

What if the interviewer seems rushed?

If they seem rushed, acknowledge it respectfully. "I know we're short on time, so I'll just ask one key question: based on our conversation, what's the single most critical challenge this role needs to solve in the first 6 months?" This shows you're observant and considerate, while still landing a powerful, focused question. It's about adapting to the situation while still making your point.

SHORT ANSWERTranslate 'fast-paced environment' as a warning that the company lacks clear processes, has shifting priorities, and expects you to manage your own chaos. It means you must make decisions with incomplete data and execute tasks quickly without waiting for permission or perfect instructions.

Seeing 'fast-paced environment' in a job posting usually makes your stomach drop because it sounds like a recipe for instant burnout. I will show you how to decode this phrase so you can spot the warning signs and prove you can handle the actual work. You will walk away with a concrete strategy to turn this vague requirement into your biggest unfair advantage.

They need I can prove Scale a team Cut churn Ship fast Hired 9 Cut it 22% Weekly ships line them up first

FIG. 02Before I write a single line, I draw two columns: what they need on the left, what I can prove on the right. Then I draw lines connecting them. The gaps that have no line tell me exactly what to address in the cover note.

  • 01 Is 'fast-paced' just code for understaffed and chaotic?

A fast-paced environment means the company has more work than people and lacks the structured systems to manage the daily overflow. It is often a direct signal that priorities change weekly, resources are scarce, and you will be expected to self-manage through constant operational friction.

I see this constantly. Startups use this phrase because they are building the plane while flying it, while larger companies use it to excuse their broken internal processes. It is a structural reality.

You need to ask the hiring manager how they prioritize projects when everything is labeled urgent. Ask them to describe a week when a major goal shifted mid-flight.

  • 02

How do I prove I can thrive in this kind of chaos?

Prove your capability by sharing specific examples of times you managed competing deadlines, made decisions with limited data, and built your own templates to survive. You must demonstrate that you do not need a perfect manual to execute your daily tasks and deliver real results.

Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to say you love speed. Do not do that. Instead, give them a concrete example, like how you managed a sudden product launch delay by shifting your team's focus to customer documentation.

For example, a customer support lead could explain how they handled a forty percent spike in tickets without extra budget by building a temporary automated triage system.

fifty generic five sharp ones weight wins, not stack height

FIG. 03I weighed fifty generic applications against five sharp ones, and the five tailored to the role still tipped the scale. Fit carries more than sheer count. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What are the red flags to watch out for in the interview?

Red flags appear when interviewers cannot define what success looks like in the first ninety days or when they brag about working late nights. If they describe the culture as a family that works hard and plays hard, expect uncompensated overtime and poor boundaries.

I want you to listen to their vocabulary. If they use words like firefighting or wearing many hats too often, run.

Here is your honest caveat. A strategic blueprint can prepare you for the interview, but it cannot fix a toxic boss once you take the job. You must use the interview to screen them just as much as they screen you.

  • 04

How does a 30/60/90 day plan help me address this?

A structured plan addresses this by showing the hiring manager you know how to onboard yourself without draining their limited time or resources. It proves you can identify quick wins, map out key stakeholders, and establish your own workflow within your first month on the job.

This is where the Baldwin Blueprint comes in. When you walk in with a 30/60/90 day plan built from their actual job posting, you show them you do not need hand-holding.

You are telling them, I see the chaos, and here is exactly how I plan to organize my first ninety days to relieve your pressure.

Worked example

Before

I work really well under pressure and I am used to fast-paced environments where things change quickly.

After

When our main supplier shut down with zero notice, I did not wait for leadership to act. I built a temporary tracking sheet, sourced three local backup vendors within forty-eight hours, and kept our production line running without a single hour of downtime.

How to handle 'fast-paced' in your application What most people do What actually works Write generic resume bullets about multitasking Quantify how you managed shifting priorities and tight deadlines Nod and say you love a challenge during the interview Ask how the team handles resource constraints and shifting goals Wait for the company to train you on their systems Present a 30/60/90 day plan showing how you will onboard yourself

The takeaways

  • 01Fast-paced usually means shifting priorities and limited resources.
  • 02Prove you can self-manage with concrete, quantified examples.
  • 03Use the interview to screen for toxic, disorganized environments.
  • 04A 30/60/90 day plan shows you do not need hand-holding.

Questions people ask

Does fast-paced always mean I will have to work overtime?

Not always, but it usually means your working hours will be intense and highly focused. It often points to poor project management, which can bleed into your personal time if you do not set firm boundaries early in your tenure.

Is Baldwin Blueprint just a fancy cover letter generator?

No, it is a comprehensive twelve page strategic document that includes an Impact Memo, Account Map, and 30/60/90 day plan. It does not write generic cover letters. It analyzes the actual job posting to build a concrete execution plan you can use in your interview.

How do I ask about work-life balance without sounding lazy?

Ask how the team prioritizes work when everything is urgent. A good manager will explain their triage process, while a bad one will tell you that everything simply has to get done, which is your cue to walk away.

Role Snapshot

At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.
